items.title: 美晶片出口管制沒用！中國大學持續取得輝達高階AI晶片
items.title_en: US Chip Export Controls Ineffective! Chinese Universities Continue to Acquire Nvidia's High-End AI Chips
paras: 《路透》報導，與中國解放軍關係密切的西北工業大學，雖已被美國列入出口管制實體清單，仍在 10 月透過中國供應商購入兩顆輝達 (NVDA-US) H200 人工智慧 (AI) 晶片，總價人民幣 87 萬 4,700 元，約 12.3 萬美元，該校今年另簽下五份算力租賃合約，取得搭載 H200 等受管制晶片的伺服器使用權，凸顯華府除了審查出口對象，也面臨晶片轉售及算力服務的監管難題。
《路透》查閱西北工業大學 10 月 21 日公布的採購紀錄發現，這兩顆 H200 由該校管理學院向陝西博算網路科技採購，交易對手為中國本地供應商。
西北工業大學位於西安，是中國「國防七子」之一，研究涵蓋軍用飛機、飛彈與衛星。美國商務部 2001 年將該校列入實體清單，2019 年進一步收緊限制，多數受管制技術的出口許可申請原則上不予核准。
該校網路安全學院今年 1 月另簽下兩份為期七個月的算力合約，每份均可使用搭載八顆 H200 的伺服器，金額分別為人民幣 44 萬 1,700 元及 44 萬 1,000 元，用於 AI 模型微調及強化學習訓練。
該校另一個研究單位 4 月也以人民幣 37 萬 5,000 元採購運算服務，要求至少使用 24 顆輝達 A100 晶片，供結構與流體力學模擬使用。
公開紀錄列出採購方、本地供應商與部分合約用途，但晶片最初如何進入中國、出租伺服器設在何處，仍有待釐清。
多所中國高校取得受管制晶片
類似交易也出現在其他高校。
深圳大學 9 月以人民幣 76 萬 9,800 元購入三顆 H100。武漢理工大學 6 月以人民幣 35 萬 5,000 元採購一台搭載 H100 的伺服器，另以人民幣 34 萬 4,000 元購入四顆 A100。
同屬「國防七子」的北京航空航天大學則在 4 月以人民幣 48 萬 9,000 元採購四顆 A800。
川普政府今年 1 月起，對符合條件的 H200 對中出口申請改採個案審查，實體清單上的機構仍受原有的終端使用者限制。
新規也要求收貨方查核客戶身分，防止未獲授權的對象遠端使用晶片。
美國國會兩黨議員正推動晶片追蹤措施及加強國會對出口許可的監督。
輝達執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 則主張，持續向中國銷售晶片，有助維持美國的技術領先地位，並讓中國客戶繼續使用美國技術。
輝達先前在財報中揭露，儘管美方自 2 月起核准向特定中國客戶少量出口 H200，北京的限制使實際出貨僅達美方核准數量的一小部分。輝達已在 2027 會計年度上半年認列 4 億美元的 H200 相關費用，涉及過剩庫存與採購承諾。依輝達當時的申報，許可計畫下的 H200 出貨占該季資料中心營收不到 1%。
Baird 分析師 Tristan Gerra 將輝達評等下調至「中立」，理由包括美國政府調查、營收風險及黃仁勳能否續任的不確定性。
Gerra 指出，若華府重新禁止 H200 對中出口，輝達可能面臨約 50 億美元的資產減記。他也預期，美方可能收緊對東南亞資料中心的出口管制，以減少受管制晶片經第三地流入中國的風險。
受黃仁勳婚外情風波牽連，AI巨頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 已連續重挫兩個交易日，週三 (11日) 逢低買盤回流，股價收紅2.92% 至每股173.73 美元，今年以來累計下滑 8%。
paras_en: Reuters reported that Northwestern Polytechnical University, which has close ties to the Chinese People’s Liberation Army and is already on the U.S. export‑control entity list, bought two Nvidia (NVDA-US) H200 artificial‑intelligence chips in October through a Chinese supplier for a total of RMB 874,700 (about $123,000). The university also signed five compute‑capacity leasing contracts this year to obtain server access that includes H200 and other restricted chips, highlighting that Washington faces not only export‑to‑entity scrutiny but also challenges regulating chip resale and compute‑as‑a‑service.

The Reuters review of Northwestern Polytechnical University’s procurement record dated 21 October shows that the two H200 chips were purchased by the university’s School of Management from Shaanxi BoSuan Network Technology, a domestic Chinese supplier.

Northwestern Polytechnical University, located in Xi’an, is one of China’s “Seven Defense Universities” and conducts research on military aircraft, missiles and satellites. The U.S. Department of Commerce added the school to the Entity List in 2001 and tightened restrictions in 2019, generally denying export licences for most controlled technologies.

In January this year, the university’s School of Cybersecurity signed two seven‑month compute contracts, each granting access to a server equipped with eight H200 chips, for RMB 441,700 and RMB 441,000 respectively, to be used for AI model fine‑tuning and reinforcement‑learning training.
Another research unit at the university purchased computing services in April for RMB 375,000, requiring the use of at least 24 Nvidia A100 chips for structural and fluid‑mechanics simulations.

Public records list the purchaser, the domestic supplier and parts of the contract purpose, but it remains unclear how the chips originally entered China and where the leased servers are physically located.
Several Chinese universities have obtained restricted chips.
Similar transactions have appeared at other universities.

Shenzhen University bought three H100 chips in September for RMB 769,800. Wuhan University of Technology purchased a server with an H100 in June for RMB 355,000 and bought four A100 chips for RMB 344,000.
Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, also a “Seven Defense University,” bought four A800 chips in April for RMB 489,000.
Since January, the Trump administration has shifted to case‑by‑case review for eligible H200 exports to China, while entities on the Entity List remain subject to the original end‑user restrictions.
The new rules also require the recipient to verify the customer’s identity to prevent unauthorized remote use of the chips.
Bipartisan members of Congress are pushing chip‑tracking measures and stronger congressional oversight of export licences.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argues that continuing to sell chips to China helps maintain U.S. technological leadership and allows Chinese customers to keep using U.S. technology.

Nvidia disclosed in its earnings that, although the U.S. approved limited H200 shipments to certain Chinese customers starting in February, Beijing’s restrictions meant actual shipments were only a small fraction of the approved amount. Nvidia recorded $400 million of H200‑related expenses in the first half of fiscal 2027, tied to excess inventory and purchase commitments. Under the licence programme, H200 shipments accounted for less than 1% of the quarter’s data‑center revenue.
Baird analyst Tristan Gerra downgraded Nvidia to a “Neutral” rating, citing U.S. government investigations, revenue risk and uncertainty over Jensen Huang’s tenure.

Gerra noted that if Washington re‑bans H200 exports to China, Nvidia could face roughly $5 billion of asset write‑downs. He also expects the U.S. may tighten export controls on Southeast Asian data centres to reduce the risk of restricted chips flowing to China via third‑party locations.

Affected by Jensen Huang’s extramarital‑affair scandal, AI giant Nvidia (NVDA-US) has fallen for two consecutive trading days; on Wednesday (the 11th) buying pressure returned, lifting the stock 2.92% to $173.73 per share, down 8% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉CoreWeave點燃AI買盤 輝達終止連二跌 費半勁揚超5.6%
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: CoreWeave Ignites AI Buying, Nvidia Stops Two-Day Decline, Philly Semiconductor Index Jumps Over 5.6%
paras: 美股週三 (11 日) 四大指數收高，AI 雲端業者 CoreWeave 第三季營收優於預期，並上調全年財測，股價飆漲近 25%，帶動 AI 概念股反彈。輝達結束連兩日跌勢，那斯達克指數上漲 1.60%，費城半導體指數勁揚 5.66%。
CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 上調 2026 年營收與營業利益展望，緩解市場對 AI 基礎設施需求的疑慮。
AI 新創 Anthropic 也在更新的申報文件中表示，計畫於下週首次公開募股 (IPO)，擬發行 8.25 億股，估值最高可達 1.4 兆美元。這筆 IPO 已獲超額認購，OpenAI 單季營收則達 100 億美元。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 週三止跌回升，執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 坦承婚外情後，輝達本週前兩個交易日累跌近 10%。兩名共和黨籍眾議員週三表示，國會已準備傳喚黃仁勳，就這段關係提供說明。
通膨數據仍牽動利率預期。美國 10 月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 月增 0.4%，高於市場預期。
芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比 (Austan Goolsbee) 形容，這份通膨報告再度令人憂心。聯準會 (Fed) 理事華勒 (Christopher Waller) 週二的談話，也推升市場對 12 月升息的預期。
芝商所 (CME) FedWatch 工具顯示，數據公布後，市場估計 12 月升息一碼的機率升至約九成。
美債現貨市場週三因退伍軍人節休市，美債期貨小幅走低，美元觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最高水準。
美股週三 (11 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 下跌 1.97%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 2.04%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 2.11%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.26%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 1.74%。
半導體指標股齊揚。AMD (AMD-US) 飆漲 7.32%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 3.99%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 2.87%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 飆漲 6.05%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.75%。
記憶體與儲存族群全面走高。美光 (MU-US) 狂升 11.89%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 暴漲 8.34%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 瘋漲 13.69%；希捷 (STX-US) 飆漲 9.99%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 狂飆 9.71%。
台股 ADR 全數收紅。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 大漲 4.25%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 猛升 6.60%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 大漲 6.91%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 微漲 0.45%。
企業新聞
CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 飆漲超 24% 至每股 60.77 美元，創2025年6月以來最強單日表現。 這家 AI 雲端業者公布亮眼的第三季財報，緩解市場對其資產負債表的疑慮。執行長英特雷特 (Michael Intrator) 表示，公司將停止在公開市場發行無擔保債券，改採過去曾使用、可在約定期限內按需提款的貸款額度。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 週三上漲 2.87%，收報 173.73 美元。投資機構 Baird 同日將輝達評等由「優於大盤」下調至「中立」，並呼籲黃仁勳辭任執行長。黃仁勳坦承與一名被指涉嫌替中國從事間諜活動的女子有婚外情後，華爾街對他的去留日益感到不安。
Nebius (NBIS-US) 飛漲逾 15% 至每股 154.69 美元。同為 AI 雲端業者的 Nebius 受到 CoreWeave 財報激勵，將於週四美股開盤前公布第三季財報。
好市多 (COST-US) 走升約 2% 至每股 1,087.61 美元。 這家倉儲式零售商宣布發放每股 30 美元的特別股息，為上一次特別股息的兩倍。董事會也重新授權 40 億美元的庫藏股計畫。
華爾街分析
貝爾德私人財富管理投資策略師 Ross Mayfield 表示，CoreWeave 財報與 Anthropic IPO 的認購需求改善了整個 AI 產業鏈的投資氣氛。上週賣壓消化後，市場正收復部分失地，許多 AI 股的短期估值與獲利前景也重新吸引買盤。
貝萊德全球固定收益投資長 Rick Rieder 研判，通膨仍高於 Fed 希望看到的水準，12 月升息是貝萊德與市場的基本預期，接下來的焦點是升息幅度。
摩根大通資產管理全球策略師 David Kelly 則認為，即使最新 CPI 高於預期，Fed 也沒有必要在 12 月升息兩碼。
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: U.S. stocks on Wednesday (the 11th) saw all four major indexes close higher. AI cloud provider CoreWeave posted third‑quarter revenue that beat expectations and raised its full‑year outlook, sending its shares up nearly 25% and sparking a rebound in AI‑related stocks. Nvidia ended a two‑day losing streak, the Nasdaq rose 1.60%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged 5.66%.
CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) lifted its 2026 revenue and operating‑income forecasts, easing market concerns about demand for AI infrastructure.

AI startup Anthropic disclosed in a filing that it plans an initial public offering next week, aiming to sell 825 million shares and valuing the company at up to $1.4 trillion. The IPO has already been oversubscribed, and OpenAI reported quarterly revenue of $10 billion.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) halted its decline on Wednesday and moved higher. CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, after which Nvidia had fallen nearly 10% over the prior two trading sessions. Two Republican members of Congress said on Wednesday that the House is prepared to summon Huang for an explanation of the relationship.
Inflation data continues to drive interest‑rate expectations. U.S. consumer price index (CPI) for October rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, above market forecasts.

Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee described the inflation report as again worrisome. Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks on Tuesday also lifted market expectations for a rate hike in December.
The CME FedWatch tool showed that after the data release, the market’s probability of a one‑point rate increase in December rose to roughly 90%.
U.S. Treasury spot markets were closed on Wednesday for Veterans Day, and Treasury futures slipped slightly while the dollar reached its highest level since May 2025.
U.S. stock market performance on Wednesday (the 11th):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 254.60 points, or 0.49%, to 52,486.49.
The Nasdaq Composite gained 400.31 points, or 1.60%, to 25,466.19.
The S&P 500 added 98.45 points, or 1.31%, to 7,619.38.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 565.78 points, or 5.66%, to 10,564.11.
The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 310.80 points, or 1.80%, to 17,585.25.

Focus stocks:
Among the five big‑tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index, gains and losses were mixed. Meta (META‑US) fell 1.97%; Apple (AAPL‑US) rose 2.04%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) climbed 2.11%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) dropped 2.26%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) slipped 1.74%.

Semiconductor bellwethers all rallied. AMD (AMD‑US) surged 7.32%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) rose 3.99%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) climbed 2.87%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) jumped 6.05%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) gained 1.75%.

Memory and storage stocks moved higher across the board. Micron (MU‑US) surged 11.89%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) leapt 8.34%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) rocketed 13.69%; Seagate (STX‑US) rose 9.99%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) spiked 9.71%.
All Taiwan‑related ADRs closed in the green. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) jumped 4.25%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) surged 6.60%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) rose 6.91%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) edged up 0.45%.
Company news:

CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) rocketed more than 24% to $60.77 per share, marking its strongest single‑day gain since June 2025. The AI cloud provider posted an impressive third‑quarter report that eased balance‑sheet concerns. CEO Michael Intrater said the company will stop issuing unsecured bonds in the public market and will instead rely on a loan facility previously used that allows drawdowns on demand within a set term.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) rose 2.87% on Wednesday, closing at $173.73. Investment firm Baird downgraded Nvidia that day from "outperform" to "neutral" and called for Jensen Huang to step down as CEO. After Huang admitted an affair with a woman alleged to have spied for China, Wall Street’s confidence in his leadership has waned.

Nebius (NBIS‑US) surged over 15% to $154.69 per share. The AI cloud competitor Nebius, buoyed by CoreWeave’s earnings, will release its own third‑quarter results before the U.S. market opens on Thursday.

Costco (COST‑US) climbed about 2% to $1,087.61 per share. The warehouse retailer announced a special dividend of $30 per share, double the previous special dividend, and the board re‑authorized a $4 billion share‑repurchase program.
Wall Street analysis:

Ross Mayfield, investment strategist at Baird Private Wealth Management, said CoreWeave’s earnings and the demand for Anthropic’s IPO have improved sentiment across the AI supply chain. After last week’s selling pressure was absorbed, the market is recapturing ground, and many AI stocks’ short‑term valuations and earnings outlooks are once again attracting buyers.

Rick Rieder, global fixed‑income chief investment officer at BlackRock, judged that inflation remains above the level the Fed wants to see, making a December rate hike the baseline expectation for BlackRock and the market, with the focus now on the size of the hike.
David Kelly, global strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, argued that even though the latest CPI came in hotter than expected, the Fed does not need to raise rates by two points in December.
All figures are updated as of the deadline; please refer to actual market quotes for final numbers.

items.title: 471億美元！川普點名以色列等六國為伊朗戰事買單　分析人士：政治姿態難兌現
items.title_en: $47.1 Billion! Trump Names Israel and Six Other Nations to Pay for the Iran War – Analysts Say the Political Gesture Is Hard to Fulfill
paras: 美國期中選舉慘敗後第三天，總統川普在電視節目中首次點名以色列、沙烏地阿拉伯、阿聯、卡達、巴林和科威特，要求它們「100%」償還美國在伊朗戰事中的開支。他說：「我們會把那些錢全部拿回來，因為如果沒有我們，它們根本不會存在。」根據五角大廈估算，截至10月16日，伊朗戰事成本達471億美元。
多位中東問題分析人士判斷，這更接近政治信號，而非可執行的政策。查塔姆研究所專家表示，川普的話最好被理解為政治姿態；科威特大學學者則稱這番話面向美國國內民眾，波斯灣國家也會這樣理解。分析師還說，川普在期中選舉後正尋找替罪羊，轉移對敗選的注意力。
歷史上，1991年波斯灣戰爭後的成本分攤因有聯合國授權而實現，而2026年伊朗戰事由美以聯合發動，波斯灣國家事先未被充分告知，兩者性質不可比。
波斯灣國家處境最為矛盾。它們不是戰爭發起方，卻承受伊朗報復性打擊的主要衝擊。沙烏地阿拉伯今年第三季度預算赤字達224億美元，卡達液化天然氣設施遭襲致年收入損失約200億美元。
安聯貿易評估，波斯灣合作委員會(GCC)今年GDP將萎縮4%，累計損失未來產出約7900億美元。在此財政狀況下，要求再付471億美元幾乎不可，波斯灣國家料將「悄悄抵制」，辯稱已通過防務合作、基地支持等付過帳，替代補償形式如投資、軍購等，本質是將既有事務重新包裝。
以色列是新變量。尼坦雅胡對要求保持沉默，背景是川普宣布年底前停止對以每年約40億美元軍援。尼坦雅胡曾提出未來十年將軍援降至零。川普雙重施壓：切斷未來援助並追討過去成本。但471億美元對以色列同樣缺乏依據，美國自1991年後從未要求以色列「償還」費用。
分析人士認為，川普開出帳單未必真正落實，波斯灣國家和以色列清楚這是政治姿態，回應方式將是等待其注意力轉移到下一個目標上。
paras_en: Three days after his disastrous midterm election loss, President Trump on a TV show for the first time singled out Israel, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait, demanding they "100%" reimburse the United States for its spending on the Iran war. He said, "We’ll take all that money back, because without us they wouldn’t exist at all." According to a Pentagon estimate, the cost of the Iran war had reached $47.1 billion as of Oct. 16.

Several Middle‑East analysts say the move is more a political signal than a feasible policy. A Chatham House expert suggested Trump’s remarks are best understood as a political posture; a scholar from Kuwait University said the comments are aimed at a domestic U.S. audience, though Gulf states will interpret them similarly. Analysts also note that Trump is looking for a scapegoat after the midterms to divert attention from his defeat.

Historically, the cost‑sharing after the 1991 Gulf War was possible because it was authorized by the United Nations, whereas the 2026 Iran conflict was launched jointly by the U.S. and Israel without fully informing Gulf states in advance, making the two situations incomparable.

Gulf states find themselves in the most contradictory position. They did not initiate the war, yet they bear the brunt of Iran’s retaliatory strikes. Saudi Arabia’s third‑quarter budget deficit this year reached $22.4 billion, and attacks on Qatar’s liquefied natural gas facilities caused an estimated annual revenue loss of about $20 billion.

Allianz Trade estimates that the Gulf Cooperation Council’s GDP will contract by 4% this year, amounting to a cumulative loss of future output of roughly $790 billion. In that fiscal context, asking for an additional $4.71 billion is virtually impossible; Gulf states are expected to “quietly resist,” arguing they have already contributed through defense cooperation, base support and other accounting measures, and that alternative compensation such as investments or arms purchases merely re‑package existing obligations.

Israel is a new variable. Prime Minister Netanyahu has remained silent on the demand, while Trump announced he would halt the roughly $4 billion per‑year U.S. military aid to Israel by year‑end. Netanyahu has previously suggested cutting that aid to zero over the next decade. Trump is applying a double pressure: cutting future aid while trying to recover past costs. Yet the $4.71 billion claim has no precedent for Israel, as the United States has never asked Israel to “repay” war expenses since 1991.

Analysts conclude that Trump’s bill is unlikely to be fully enforced; Gulf states and Israel recognize it as a political gesture and are likely to respond by waiting for his attention to shift to the next target.

石油輸出國組織與盟國(OPEC+)10月原油產量大增，增幅主要來自沙烏地阿拉伯，但荷莫茲海峽航運中斷仍未見緩解。華盛頓近東政策研究所資料顯示，10月共有37艘船遭到攻擊，是2月戰爭開始以來單月最高紀錄。
XS.com業務發展主管西蒙-彼得・馬薩布尼表示，外交訊號轉趨正面，不代表航運營運風險已消失；即使達成政治協議，航運也不太可能立即恢復正常。伊朗部隊攻擊阿曼迪達馬爾島的船舶導航系統，顯示伊朗仍有能力鎖定恢復波斯灣石油運輸所需的基礎設施。
倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)石油研究部門11月10日報告指出，即使達成協議，水道運輸量要回升仍取決於水雷清除進度、保險成本，以及船東是否願意承擔風險。

Kpler資料顯示，中東原油與凝析油供應中斷量已降至每日約380萬桶；沙烏地阿拉伯與伊拉克原油產量均回到戰前水準，兩國供應中斷也大幅減少。

烏克蘭軍方周三表示，無人機襲擊俄羅斯波羅的海主要港口烏斯季盧加，引發火災並損壞部分儲油罐設施。業界消息人士指出，自10月下旬烏克蘭恢復無人機攻擊以來，俄羅斯煉油能力已減少約30%。
paras_en: Reuters, New York, Nov 11 – Iran’s security chief said Tehran will not allow any enriched nuclear material to leave Iran, easing market fears of supply risk and pushing oil prices up about 1% on Wednesday from the two‑month low hit the previous trading day.

The United States said the nuclear issue must be included in initial talks with Iran, aiming to end the US‑Israel war against Tehran. Brent crude futures rose $1.27, up 1.39% to $92.76 a barrel; US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) gained 49 cents, up 0.57% to $86.53 a barrel.

On the prior trading day oil prices fell more than $3 a barrel, mainly because US officials downplayed the need for further military strikes on Iran. Later, an Iranian security official said no negotiations had taken place, allowing oil to recoup part of the loss. UBS analyst Giovanni Stanovo said market expectations that the situation would ease have weakened, supporting prices.

OPEC+ oil output surged in October, largely driven by Saudi Arabia, but disruptions in the Hormuz Strait shipping lane have not eased. Data from the Washington Institute for Near East Policy show 37 vessels were attacked in October, the highest monthly total since the war began in February.

Simon‑Peter Masabuni, head of business development at XS.com, said improving diplomatic signals do not mean shipping risks have vanished; even if a political deal is reached, shipping is unlikely to return to normal immediately. Iranian forces’ attack on a vessel’s navigation system near Oman’s Damar Island shows Iran still can target infrastructure needed to resume Persian Gulf oil flows.

A November 10 report from the London Stock Exchange Group’s oil research unit noted that even with an agreement, the rebound in waterway volumes depends on mine‑clearing progress, insurance costs, and whether ship owners are willing to take the risk.

Since the start of the month, markets have sharply cut oil prices in anticipation of an end to the war, with Brent and WTI down about 21% and 17% respectively. However, US crude inventories rose by 9 million barrels last week, and industry sources citing the American Petroleum Institute said official inventory data were delayed to Thursday—one day later than scheduled because Wednesday was US Veterans Day.

Kpler data show Middle‑East crude and condensate supply disruptions have fallen to roughly 3.8 million barrels per day; Saudi and Iraqi crude output has returned to pre‑war levels, and their supply interruptions have also dropped markedly.

Russian and Ukrainian negotiators said the two‑day peace talks in Abu Dhabi, which concluded on Wednesday, yielded some progress; but US mediators noted the parties still lack trust and disagree on major issues such as territory. Analyst Pavel Morozhanov of Raymond James said the Russia‑Ukraine war is nearing five years, and despite years of diplomatic attempts, the market will only believe in peace progress when concrete results appear.

The Ukrainian military said on Wednesday that drones attacked Russia’s Baltic port of Ust‑Luga, causing a fire and damaging part of the oil‑storage facilities. Industry sources said that since Ukraine resumed drone strikes in late October, Russian refining capacity has fallen by about 30%.

items.title: 黃仁勳不知黃樂是中國間諜？前CIA官員存疑：「他不可能這麼天真」
items.title_en: Did Jensen Huang Not Know Alice Huang Was a Chinese Spy? Former CIA Officer Doubts: "He Could Not Be That Naïve"
paras: 美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 週一 (9 日) 表示，輝達執行長黃仁勳宣稱完全不知道黃樂(Alice Huang) 涉嫌從事情報活動，對此，前美國中央情報局 (CIA) 中國事務分析師 Dennis Wilder 對此抱持懷疑稱：「他深諳華人文化，不可能這麼天真。」
黃仁勳絕非沒見過世面的小白兔？
《華盛頓郵報》報導，與黃仁勳交往的黃樂曾任輝達高階晶片買家 Megaspeed 的高階主管，美方情報人員懷疑她曾為北京工作。輝達董事會已宣布展開內部調查，新加坡當局也正調查 Megaspeed 是否協助將先進晶片轉運至中國。
美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 週一 (9 日) 表示，他與黃仁勳談過此事，黃仁勳告訴他，自己完全不知道對方涉嫌從事情報活動。
Wilder 對此評價：「這麼說吧，他可不是堪薩斯州托彼卡 (Topeka) 人，即絕非沒見過世面的小白兔，他深諳華人文化，不可能那麼天真。」
從私人關係接近決策圈　晶片買家身分也受關注
Wilder 指出，情報機構可以透過私人關係接近掌握敏感資訊的人。即使接觸者未受過正式情報訓練，也可能藉由這層關係接觸原本難以接近的人員或取得敏感資訊。
黃仁勳掌握輝達的商業決策，也代表公司與華府就晶片政策溝通，使這段關係受到國安界關注。
黃樂曾任職的 Megaspeed 採購輝達高階晶片。新加坡當局正在調查，這家公司是否透過東南亞將先進晶片轉運至中國。
新加坡內政部上月表示，不容許企業利用與新加坡的關聯，刻意規避或違反其他國家的出口管制。
黃樂是否參與任何轉運，以及相關交易是否與她和黃仁勳的關係有關，仍未有公開調查結論。
1980 年代曾攔下攜磁片赴北京主管　企業拒絕配合起訴
黃仁勳婚外情風波，亦讓美國科技業長期面對的反間諜問題再度受到關注。
曾參與辦案的前美國聯邦調查局 (FBI) 反間諜探員 LaRae Quy 指出，早在 1980 年代末期，FBI 就曾鎖定一名涉嫌替中國從事情報活動的矽谷科技公司主管。
該公司當時從事可用於軍事用途的機密研究，探員跟監並監聽這位高層，最後在他企圖攜帶一張磁片從舊金山飛往北京時將他逮捕。
不過，案件在逮捕後失去進展。
Quy說，該公司擔心負面報導，拒絕配合後續起訴，聯邦官員也未繼續追究。
她回憶，當時有企業寧可承受技術外流的損失，也不願面對案件曝光可能帶來的聲譽與股價衝擊。
AI 競爭升高　美方查辦商業機密竊取與晶片走私
如今，美方追查的範圍已涵蓋 AI 超級電腦架構與先進晶片的跨境流向。
美國法院今年 1 月裁定，前 Google 工程師丁林葳 (Linwei Ding) 所涉 7 項經濟間諜罪及 7 項竊取商業機密罪均成立。案件涉及逾 2,000 頁有關 Google AI 超級電腦架構的機密資料。
美國執法機關也查辦多起涉嫌將輝達先進技術轉運至中國的案件。
其中一案規模約 1.6 億美元，涉案人員被控以不實出貨文件規避出口管制。
另一起案件涉及約 25 億美元的 AI 伺服器採購，檢方指控相關受管制技術遭轉運至中國。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday (the 9th) that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang claimed he had no knowledge that Alice Huang was suspected of engaging in intelligence activities, and former CIA China analyst Dennis Wilder expressed skepticism, saying, "He is well-versed in Chinese culture and could not be that naïve."
Jensen Huang is far from being an inexperienced newcomer?

The Washington Post reported that Alice Huang, who has dealings with Jensen Huang, previously held a senior executive position at Nvidia's high‑end chip buyer Megaspeed, and U.S. intelligence officials suspect she may have worked for Beijing. Nvidia's board has announced an internal investigation, and Singapore authorities are also probing whether Megaspeed helped ship advanced chips to China.
President Trump said on Monday (the 9th) that he had discussed the matter with Jensen Huang, who told him he was completely unaware of any intelligence‑related allegations against the other party.
Wilder commented, "In other words, he's not a small‑town kid from Topeka, Kansas – certainly not an inexperienced newcomer. He knows Chinese culture inside out and could not be that naïve."
Approaching the decision‑making circle through personal ties – the chip buyer’s identity also draws attention

Wilder noted that intelligence agencies can use personal relationships to get close to people who hold sensitive information. Even if the contact lacks formal intelligence training, the relationship can provide access to otherwise hard‑to‑reach personnel or sensitive data.
Jensen Huang controls Nvidia’s business decisions and also represents the company in communications with Washington on chip policy, making this relationship a focus for national‑security officials.
Megaspeed, where Alice Huang previously worked, purchased high‑end Nvidia chips. Singapore authorities are investigating whether the firm used Southeast Asia to reroute advanced chips to China.
Singapore’s Ministry of Home Affairs said last month that companies are not allowed to use ties to Singapore to deliberately evade or violate other countries’ export controls.
Whether Alice Huang participated in any rerouting and whether related transactions are linked to her relationship with Jensen Huang remain without a public investigative conclusion.
In the 1980s, a senior official who tried to take a magnetic disk to Beijing was stopped – the company refused to cooperate with prosecution
Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair scandal has also revived attention to the long‑standing counter‑espionage issues facing the U.S. tech sector.
Former FBI counter‑espionage agent LaRae Quy, who worked on the case, said that as early as the late 1980s the FBI had targeted a senior Silicon Valley tech executive suspected of spying for China.

The company at the time was conducting classified research with potential military applications; agents surveilled and tapped the executive, and ultimately arrested him when he attempted to fly a magnetic disk from San Francisco to Beijing.
However, the case stalled after the arrest.
Quy said the company feared negative publicity, refused to cooperate with further prosecution, and federal officials did not pursue the matter further.
She recalled that companies sometimes prefer to endure the loss of technology leakage rather than face the reputational and stock‑price damage that could arise from a public case.
AI competition is intensifying, and U.S. authorities are investigating commercial espionage and chip smuggling.
Today, U.S. investigations cover cross‑border flows of AI supercomputer architectures and advanced chips.

In January this year, a U.S. court found former Google engineer Linwei Ding guilty on seven counts of economic espionage and seven counts of trade‑secret theft, involving over 2,000 pages of confidential material on Google’s AI supercomputer architecture.
U.S. law‑enforcement agencies are also probing multiple cases alleged to involve the transfer of Nvidia’s advanced technology to China.
One case involves roughly $160 million, with defendants charged with using false shipping documents to evade export controls.
Another case concerns about $2.5 billion in AI server purchases, with prosecutors alleging that controlled technology was rerouted to China.

items.title: 輝達客戶Megaspeed為何未列黑名單？貝森特白宮質問盧特尼克
items.title_en: Why Is Nvidia Customer Megaspeed Not Blacklisted? Bessent Questions Lutnick at the White House
paras: 《Axios》報導，美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 上週在白宮戰情室當面追問商務部長盧特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)，為何涉嫌將輝達 (NVDA-US) 先進人工智慧 (AI) 晶片轉運至中國的經銷商 Megaspeed，至今仍未被列入美國商務部的實體清單。
這場交鋒凸顯，川普政府內部對於是否應限制這家輝達大客戶取得美國技術，以及此舉可能對美中貿易關係造成的影響，存在分歧。
據知悉會議內容的人士透露，貝森特在會中問道：「為什麼 Megaspeed 還沒被列入實體清單？」
盧特尼克一時語塞，隨後表示：「我不知道，我會查一下。」
企業一旦被列入實體清單，供應商向其出口、再出口或移轉受管制產品，通常須先取得美國商務部許可，實際限制取決於個別列名條件。
白宮與情報官員自去年秋季促請商務部介入
知情人士報導，白宮與美國情報機構官員自 2025 年秋季起便敦促商務部採取行動。兼任國家安全顧問的國務卿盧比歐 (Marco Rubio) 也曾向盧特尼克提交備忘錄，詳列 Megaspeed 涉及的國安疑慮。
知情人士稱，盧特尼克過去一年多次擋下或撤回其他官員推動的措施，因為擔心對 Megaspeed 出手會使美中貿易關係進一步緊張。
《紐約時報》另報導，輝達介入後，商務部主管出口管制的次長凱斯勒 (Jeffrey Kessler) 曾突然叫停一項針對 Megaspeed 的調查。
貝森特此次追問的是商務部是否對 Megaspeed 採取出口限制，而這項報導則將焦點拉回商務部先前如何處理相關調查。
逾 48 億美元晶片採購受查 輝達董事會調查黃仁勳
據報，Megaspeed 曾採購逾 48 億美元的輝達先進晶片。美方調查焦點在於其中是否有晶片遭轉運至中國、最終流向哪些企業，以及相關交易有無違反美國出口管制。
48 億美元是據報採購總額，實際流入中國的金額仍待釐清。
Megaspeed 前高層黃樂 (Alice Huang) 被指透過與輝達執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 及輝達經銷商的關係，協助中國企業取得晶片。
美國情報官員懷疑黃樂涉及中國情報活動。
輝達上週日披露，黃仁勳向董事會告知兩人的親密關係後，董事會將展開調查。黃仁勳否認知悉任何間諜行動。
《紐約時報》報導，美國官員曾在 5 月向川普簡報黃樂與中國政府的疑似關聯。
川普近日被問及此事時，仍公開肯定黃仁勳，稱他是個正派的人，可能有理由解釋，並表示他為美國做了很出色的工作。
觀察出口許可 黃仁勳在華府的影響力恐受削弱
科技研究機構 Moor Insights & Strategy 執行長 Patrick Moorhead 先前指出，這場風波已削弱黃仁勳在華府推動出口政策的影響力，美國政府日後審查輝達對中出口許可時，可能將此事納入考量。
對輝達而言，近期要觀察的是商務部會否將 Megaspeed 列入實體清單。
若限制進一步擴及其他經銷商或海外轉售管道，輝達面臨的影響就會從單一客戶交易，延伸到更多通路的最終買家查核與出口許可審查。
paras_en: Axios reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent last week confronted Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick face‑to‑face in the White House war room, asking why the Nvidia (NVDA-US) advanced AI chip distributor Megaspeed, which is suspected of shipping chips to China, has not yet been placed on the Commerce Department’s Entity List.

The showdown highlighted internal divisions within the Trump administration over whether this major Nvidia customer should be barred from accessing U.S. technology and the potential impact such a move could have on U.S.–China trade relations.
People familiar with the meeting said Bessent asked, “Why hasn’t Megaspeed been added to the Entity List yet?”
Lutnick was momentarily at a loss for words and later replied, “I don’t know, I’ll look into it.”

When a company is placed on the Entity List, suppliers must generally obtain a Commerce Department license before exporting, re‑exporting, or transferring controlled items to it, and the actual restrictions depend on the specific listing criteria.
The White House and intelligence officials have been urging the Commerce Department to act since last fall.

Sources reported that the White House and U.S. intelligence officials have been pressing the Commerce Department since the autumn of 2025. National Security Advisor and Secretary of State Marco Rubio also submitted a memorandum to Lutnick outlining national‑security concerns involving Megaspeed.

Sources said Lutnick has repeatedly blocked or withdrawn measures proposed by other officials over the past year, fearing that taking action against Megaspeed would further strain U.S.–China trade ties.
The New York Times also reported that after Nvidia became involved, Commerce Department deputy assistant secretary for export controls Jeffrey Kessler abruptly halted an investigation into Megaspeed.

Bessent’s line of questioning focused on whether the Commerce Department has imposed export restrictions on Megaspeed, while the report shifts attention back to how the department previously handled related investigations.
More than $4.8 billion in chip purchases under investigation – Nvidia board probes Jensen Huang.

According to reports, Megaspeed purchased over $4.8 billion worth of Nvidia’s advanced chips. U.S. investigators are looking into whether any of those chips were shipped to China, which companies ultimately received them, and whether the transactions violated U.S. export controls.
The $4.8 billion figure reflects the reported total purchase amount; the actual value that may have ended up in China remains to be clarified.
Former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang is accused of leveraging her relationships with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Nvidia’s distributors to help Chinese firms obtain the chips.
U.S. intelligence officials suspect that Alice Huang is involved in Chinese intelligence activities.

Nvidia disclosed last Sunday that after Jensen Huang informed the board of his close relationship with Huang, the board will launch an investigation. Huang denied any knowledge of espionage activities.
The New York Times reported that U.S. officials briefed Trump in May about the alleged link between Alice Huang and the Chinese government.

When Trump was recently asked about the matter, he publicly defended Jensen Huang, calling him an upstanding person who may have a reason to explain himself and saying Huang has done an excellent job for the United States.
Observing export licenses, Jensen Huang’s influence in Washington may be weakened.

Patrick Moorhead, CEO of research firm Moor Insights & Strategy, previously noted that the controversy has eroded Huang’s sway over export‑policy lobbying in Washington, and that the U.S. government may factor the issue into future reviews of Nvidia’s export licenses to China.
For Nvidia, the immediate focus is whether the Commerce Department will add Megaspeed to the Entity List.

If restrictions expand to other distributors or overseas resale channels, Nvidia’s exposure could grow from a single‑customer deal to broader scrutiny of downstream buyers and additional export‑license reviews.

items.title: 台橡(2103) 前 3 季多賺 19 億元！第 3 季毛利率 10.44% 已逼近去年全年 9.8%
items.title_en: Taiwan Rubber (2103) Gains NT$1.9 Billion in First Three Quarters! Q3 Gross Margin 10.44% Near Last Year's Full-Year 9.8%
paras: 2026年11月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 台橡(2103-TW) 2026 年前 3 季稅後淨利 20.8 億元、每股獲利 2.52 元，2025 年同期僅 1.8 億元、每股 0.22 元，淨利增加 19 億元。
毛利的分布更能說明這筆成長從哪裡來。前 3 季毛利 49.08 億元、年增 79%，2025 年同期為 27.35 億元，差額 21.73 億元；2026 與 2025 年上半年毛利分別為 37.79 億元與 19.51 億元，差額 18.28 億元佔八成四。
第 2 季單季毛利 25.13 億元，佔前 3 季毛利的一半；單季毛利率 21.15%，第 3 季降至 10.44%，一季減少 10.71 個百分點。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，台橡 2026 年第 2 季三條利潤率同步衝高，第 3 季毛利率、營業利益率與稅後淨利率同時回落，營收仍高於 2025 年同期。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
公司在法說會上把獲利歸因於供給端。中東衝突打亂石化供應鏈，同業因原料取得不易而減少供給，供給收縮使價格維持在高檔；台橡則將上漲的原料成本轉嫁，公司表示「利差擴大是由供應鏈不確定性所驅動」。
需求動能只有 SEBS前 3 季合成橡膠三條產品線中，ESBR 銷量與 2025 年同期持平、獲利增加，原因在同業供給減少與成本轉嫁。BR 銷量與獲利均略有增加。SSBR 銷量與獲利各減少個位數，公司歸因於 2026 年初存貨水位偏低。

TPE 為熱可塑性彈性體，旗下 SBS、SIS、SEBS 三項同屬這六條產品線。SEBS 是 TPE 中表現最好的一項：下游客戶提高庫存意願，中國玩具市場第 2 季到第 3 季需求暢旺，銷量與獲利均顯著成長。SIS 銷量成長個位數，獲利成長落後於銷量，公司歸因於原料價格與客戶組合。SBS 受惠 2025 年第 4 季訂單遞延至 2026 年第 1 季出貨，加上美國市場議定的合約公式定價優於前一年，銷量與獲利均大幅成長。
六條產品線中只有 SEBS 的成長由下游客戶回補庫存與中國玩具需求帶動，其餘多與供給端出現問題或訂單時點挪移有關。第 3 季合成橡膠市場需求放緩，公司維持核心客戶基礎，並受惠 SEBS 業務成長，當季營收仍高於 2025 年同期，毛利率則低於第 2 季。
丁二烯漲價壓力未解丁二烯是合成橡膠的主要原料，這一輪的利差高低由它決定。公司指出，丁二烯每公噸報價在 2026 年 4 月接近 2,700 美元，為近 5 年高點，5 月以後隨原油下滑，7、8 月又轉為回升。
第 2 季毛利率高點落在原料 4 月見頂前後；7、8 月原料重新走高，第 3 季毛利率同步回落。公司表示「持續落實我們價格管理及商業紀律，在反映成本變動的同時，確保為客戶提供競爭力且高價值的解決方案」。
公司預期丁二烯價格維持堅挺到 2027 年第 1 季。亞洲裂解廠利用率極低，且仍有許多計畫檢修與停產，2026 年 11 月到貨量不多，現貨供應相對緊張。
需求端方面，合成橡膠需求穩定，下游 ABS、SBS 廠則因丁二烯價格偏高、購買意願轉弱；遠洋貨受運費上漲、套利空間有限影響，流入受限。
前 3 季 49.08 億元的毛利，來自原料斷鏈帶來的一段利差，需求端並沒有提供助力。第 3 季合併毛利率 10.44%，已回到 2025 年全年 9.8% 的水準附近。

paras_en: November 12, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Taiwan Rubber (2103‑TW) posted a net profit after tax of NT$2.08 billion for the first three quarters of 2026, earnings per share of NT$2.52, compared with NT$180 million and NT$0.22 per share in the same period of 2025, an increase of NT$1.9 billion in net profit.

The composition of gross profit clarifies where the growth came from. Gross profit for the first three quarters was NT$4.908 billion, up 79% year‑over‑year; it was NT$2.735 billion in the same period of 2025, a difference of NT$2.173 billion. For the first half of 2026 gross profit was NT$3.779 billion versus NT$1.951 billion in the first half of 2025, a gap of NT$1.828 billion, accounting for about 84% of the total increase.

Quarter‑2 gross profit was NT$2.513 billion, half of the total gross profit for the first three quarters. The quarterly gross margin was 21.15%, falling to 10.44% in quarter 3 – a decline of 10.71 percentage points in one quarter.

According to the chart from U‑Analysis’s industry database, Taiwan Rubber’s three profit‑margin ratios all surged in Q2 2026, then gross margin, operating margin and net‑after‑tax margin all slipped in Q3, while revenue remained higher than in the same period of 2025.
Source: U‑Analysis Industry Database

The company attributed the profit boost to the supply side during its earnings briefing. Middle‑East conflicts disrupted petrochemical supply chains, causing peers to face raw‑material shortages and reduce supply, which kept prices high. Taiwan Rubber passed the higher raw‑material costs onto customers, stating that “the widening spread is driven by supply‑chain uncertainty.”

Demand momentum was limited to SEBS among the three synthetic‑rubber product lines. ESBR sales were flat year‑over‑year but profit rose, thanks to peers’ reduced supply and cost pass‑through. BR sales and profit rose modestly. SSBR sales and profit each fell by single‑digit percentages, which the company blamed on low inventory levels at the start of 2026.

TPE (thermoplastic elastomers) includes SBS, SIS and SEBS, three of the six product lines. SEBS performed best: downstream customers increased inventory holdings, and China’s toy market saw strong demand from Q2 to Q3, driving both sales and profit sharply higher. SIS sales grew by single digits, but profit lagged behind sales due to raw‑material prices and customer mix. SBS benefited from orders postponed from Q4 2025 to Q1 2026 and from a contract‑price formula in the U.S. market that was more favorable than the previous year, resulting in large gains in both sales and profit.

Among the six product lines, only SEBS growth was driven by downstream inventory replenishment and Chinese toy demand; the others were mainly affected by supply‑side issues or timing shifts of orders. Synthetic‑rubber demand slowed in Q3, but the company kept its core customer base and benefited from SEBS growth, so quarterly revenue stayed above the 2025 level, while gross margin fell below the Q2 level.

Butadiene price pressure remains unresolved. Butadiene, the main raw material for synthetic rubber, determines the spread. The company noted that butadiene was priced near US$2,700 per metric ton in April 2026 – a five‑year high – and fell after May as oil prices dropped, then rose again in July‑August.

The Q2 gross‑margin peak occurred just before raw‑material prices peaked in April; raw‑material prices rose again in July‑August, and the Q3 gross margin fell in tandem. The company said, “We continue to enforce our price‑management and commercial discipline, reflecting cost changes while ensuring competitive, high‑value solutions for customers.”

The company expects butadiene prices to stay strong through Q1 2027. Asian cracker utilization is extremely low, with many plants scheduled for maintenance or shutdown, resulting in limited deliveries in November 2026 and relatively tight spot supply.

On the demand side, synthetic‑rubber demand remains stable, but downstream ABS and SBS plants are weakening purchase intent due to high butadiene prices. Ocean freight cost increases and limited arbitrage opportunities also restrict inbound shipments.

The NT$4.908 billion gross profit for the first three quarters stemmed from a spread created by raw‑material supply disruptions; the demand side did not provide support. The combined Q3 gross margin of 10.44% has returned to a level close to the full‑year 2025 figure of 9.8%.

items.title: 印度與南通兩家合資公司貢獻台橡(2103) 九成三業外收益，但增加的 7.19 億元它們只占三成四
items.title_en: India and Nantong Joint Ventures Contribute 93% of Taiwan Rubber (2103) Non‑Operating Income, Yet Their Added NT$719 Million Accounts for Only About 34%
paras: 2026年11月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 台橡(2103-TW) 2026 年前 3 季稅前淨利 35.95 億元，2025 年同期為 6.85 億元。這 35.95 億元中，本業營業利益 28.6 億元為主體，業外收支 7.35 億元，佔稅前淨利兩成。
業外收支這 7.35 億元幾乎全部來自兩家合資公司。印度合資公司 ISRPL 由台橡與印度國營的印度石油公司（Indian Oil）合資，前 3 季認列 5.86 億元；南通生產丁腈橡膠的阿朗台橡認列 9,800 萬元，兩家合計 6.84 億元，佔九成三。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，台橡業外收支 2026 年三季均為正數，2025 年僅第 3 季為負。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
ISRPL 的 5.86 億元高於 2025 年同期的 4 億元。公司歸因於印度內需市場需求強勁，加上丁二烯的計價公式對其有利。
阿朗台橡從 3,700 萬元增加到 9,800 萬元，增加 6,100 萬元。公司表示「銷售量是差不多的，但是獲利有明顯的增長」，差別在價格：供應鏈不確定讓下游客戶願意接受相對較高的價格，新廠的規模經濟與自法國引進的高附加價值產品亦有助益。
兩家都不進合併營收ISRPL 由台橡持股五成，主要供應印度當地輪胎廠；阿朗台橡同為持股五成的合資公司，設於南通。兩家均為權益法認列的轉投資，台橡按持股比率認列損益、列於業外，其營收不會按比率併入台橡的合併營收。
這也是台橡合併營收中看不到這兩家的原因。這 7.35 億元業外收益中，匯兌僅貢獻 500 多萬元，其餘幾乎都是轉投資。2025 年同期匯兌為正 1.25 億元。
合資的成長來自價格合資公司的售價依原料公式調整，原料上漲即帶動售價墊高，同樣的銷量就能放大獲利。
不過業外的增加不全來自這兩家。2025 年同期業外淨額僅 1,600 萬元：兩家合計認列 4.37 億元，被兩家以外的負 4.21 億元抵銷，匯兌即記在該項目。2026 年兩家認列 6.84 億元，兩家以外的項目轉為正 0.51 億元，合計才達到 7.35 億元。兩年相差 7.19 億元，兩家僅貢獻 2.47 億元、約三成四，其餘 4.72 億元來自兩家以外的業外項目。

paras_en: Nov 12, 2026 (Youshi Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Taiwan Rubber (2103‑TW) posted pre‑tax net profit of NT$3.595 billion for the first three quarters of 2026, compared with NT$685 million for the same period in 2025. Of the NT$3.595 billion, operating profit from core business was NT$2.86 billion, while non‑operating income was NT$735 million, representing 20% of pre‑tax profit.

The NT$735 million of non‑operating income came almost entirely from two joint‑venture companies. The Indian JV ISRPL, a partnership between Taiwan Rubber and state‑owned Indian Oil, recorded NT$586 million for the first three quarters; the Nantong‑based nitrile rubber producer Alang Taiwan Rubber contributed NT$98 million, together amounting to NT$684 million, or 93% of the total.
As shown in the chart, according to Youshi Analysis’s industry database, Taiwan Rubber’s non‑operating results were positive in all three quarters of 2026, whereas in 2025 only Q3 was negative.
(Source: Youshi Analysis Industry Database)

ISRPL’s NT$586 million was higher than the NT$400 million recorded in the same period of 2025. The company attributes the increase to strong domestic demand in India and a favorable pricing formula for butadiene.

Alang Taiwan Rubber’s figure rose from NT$37 million to NT$98 million, an increase of NT$61 million. The company said “sales volume was roughly the same, but profit grew markedly,” noting that price differences stemmed from supply‑chain uncertainty that led downstream customers to accept higher prices, as well as economies of scale at the new plant and high‑value‑added products imported from France.

Both ventures are accounted for under the equity method and are not consolidated into Taiwan Rubber’s revenue. ISRPL is 50% owned by Taiwan Rubber and mainly supplies local tire manufacturers in India; Alang Taiwan Rubber is also a 50% joint venture located in Nantong. Their results are recorded as non‑operating items, not proportionally merged into consolidated revenue.

That is why these two entities do not appear in Taiwan Rubber’s consolidated revenue. Of the NT$735 million non‑operating gain, foreign‑exchange effects contributed only about NT$5 million; the rest is almost entirely from equity‑method investments. In the same period of 2025, foreign‑exchange contributed a positive NT$125 million.

The growth of the joint ventures is driven by price adjustments tied to raw‑material formulas; when raw‑material costs rise, selling prices are raised accordingly, so the same sales volume yields higher profit.

However, the increase in non‑operating income is not solely from these two ventures. In 2025, non‑operating net was only NT$16 million: the two ventures contributed NT$437 million, offset by a NT$421 million loss from other items, with foreign‑exchange recorded in that category. In 2026, the two ventures contributed NT$684 million, while other items turned positive at NT$51 million, bringing the total to NT$735 million. The year‑over‑year difference of NT$719 million means the two ventures contributed only NT$247 million, about 34%, with the remaining NT$472 million coming from other non‑operating items.

items.title: 資本支出佔營收拉到 10.58%，台橡(2103) 6 萬噸 SSBR 新線 2027 年才機械竣工
items.title_en: Capital Expenditure Reached 10.58% of Revenue; Taiwan Rubber (2103) SSBR New Line of 60,000 Tons Won't Be Mechanically Completed Until 2027
paras: 2026年11月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 台橡(2103-TW) 2026 年第 3 季資本支出 11.44 億元，佔當季營收 108.17 億元的 10.58%，高於第 1 季的 5.73% 與第 2 季的 7.59%。這個比重上一次更高是 2024 年第 2 季的 13.22%，之後八季都落在 2.8% 到 7.6% 之間。同一段時間，毛利率從第 2 季的 21.15% 降至第 3 季的 10.44%。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，台橡資本支出佔營收比重從 2026 年第 1 季走高到第 3 季，毛利率在第 2 季衝高、第 3 季回到個位數，兩條線在第 2 季之後反向。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
資本支出的增加對應兩項專案。一是子公司申華化學在南通新建的合成橡膠廠，該廠已經投產；另一是同一個基地內的 SSBR 新產線，年產能 6 萬噸，仍在興建。
SSBR 是溶聚丁苯橡膠，用於要求低滾動阻力、濕地抓地力強的高性能輪胎，電動車胎與綠色輪胎為主要應用。台橡把綠色輪胎、電動車胎、醫療應用與電子電池材料並列為長期成長領域，SSBR 新線即為這個方向的產能。
建廠與認證同步台橡 2025 年 9 月公告，這條線已在南通動工，預計 2027 年完成機械竣工。機械竣工指廠房與設備安裝完成、尚未進入試產。
公司表示「客戶的認證工作也持續取得進展」，為切入高端輪胎市場及商業化規模成長做好準備。認證工作在機械竣工之前已經展開，量產則須待產線安裝完成後才會啟動。
產能過剩下仍加碼醫療公司對 2027 年的市場看法保守。產業產能過剩顯著、終端需求疲軟，許多石化與化學材料產品的定價能力受到壓抑，各國關稅與非關稅措施也在重組貿易流向。
在這種環境下，醫療級產品的認證與合作仍在推進。公司表示與全球客戶的進展順利，已開始看到初步商業成果；醫療應用的門檻在於品質、法規與長期合作。
2026 年前 3 季資本支出累計 26.39 億元，第 1 季 5.92 億元、第 2 季 9.02 億元，逐季走高，為 2025 年全年 13.92 億元的 1.9 倍。這條新線 2027 年才機械竣工，產能要到那之後才會開出。

paras_en: November 12, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Taiwan Rubber (2103‑TW) recorded capital expenditures of NT$1.144 billion in Q3 2026, representing 10.58% of the quarter’s revenue of NT$10.817 billion, higher than 5.73% in Q1 and 7.59% in Q2. The last time the ratio was higher was in Q2 2024 at 13.22%; the subsequent eight quarters ranged between 2.8% and 7.6%. Over the same period, gross margin fell from 21.15% in Q2 to 10.44% in Q3.

The chart below, based on U‑Analysis’s industry database, shows Taiwan Rubber’s capital‑expenditure‑to‑revenue ratio rising from Q1 to Q3 2026, while gross margin peaked in Q2 and returned to single‑digit levels in Q3, with the two lines moving in opposite directions after Q2.
Source: U‑Analysis Industry Database

The increase in capital spending corresponds to two projects. One is a synthetic rubber plant newly built by subsidiary Shinhwa Chemical in Nantong, which is already in operation; the other is a new SSBR production line at the same site, with an annual capacity of 60,000 tonnes, still under construction.

SSBR is solution‑polymerized styrene‑butadiene rubber used for high‑performance tires that require low rolling resistance and strong wet‑road grip; electric‑vehicle tires and “green” tires are its main applications. Taiwan Rubber lists green tires, EV tires, medical uses and electronic‑battery materials as long‑term growth areas, and the new SSBR line adds capacity for that direction.

The plant and certification were announced in September 2025; the line broke ground in Nantong and is expected to reach mechanical completion in 2027. Mechanical completion means the factory and equipment are installed, but trial production has not yet begun.

The company said “customer certification work is also making progress,” preparing it to enter the high‑end tire market and achieve commercial‑scale growth. Certification activities start before mechanical completion, while mass production will commence only after the line is fully installed.

Despite excess capacity, the company remains cautious about the 2027 market outlook for medical products. Industry overcapacity is pronounced and end‑demand is weak, suppressing pricing power for many petrochemical and chemical‑material products, while tariffs and non‑tariff measures are reshaping trade flows.

In this environment, certification and cooperation for medical‑grade products continue to advance. The company reports smooth progress with global customers and early commercial results; medical applications hinge on quality, regulations and long‑term partnerships.

Cumulative capital expenditures for the first three quarters of 2026 total NT$2.639 billion (Q1 NT$592 million, Q2 NT$902 million), rising each quarter and amounting to 1.9 times the full‑year 2025 figure of NT$1.392 billion. The new line will not be mechanically completed until 2027, and capacity will only become available thereafter.

items.title: 友通(2397) 原料達去年同期 3.1 倍！47.61 億元存貨背後的交期壓力
items.title_en: U-Tong (2397) Raw Materials Reach 3.1 Times Last Year’s Level! The Delivery Pressure Behind NT$4.761 Billion Inventory
paras: 2026年11月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 友通(2397-TW) 2026 年第 3 季底存貨 47.61 億元，占總資產 30%，較 2025 年底的 21% 增加 9 個百分點。公司在法說會上表示，存貨增加反映營運規模擴大，以及為後續供應鏈交付所做的準備。
新增資金幾乎都投入原料。第 3 季原料 29.84 億元，是去年同期 9.61 億元的 3.1 倍，占存貨比重由 41% 升至 63%。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，存貨從 2024 年的 20 億元上下增加至 2026 年第 3 季的 47.6 億元，增加部分幾乎都集中在圖中最上層的原料，製成品僅增加兩成。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
製成品及商品 12.22 億元，較去年同期的 10.01 億元增加兩成；在製品 4.66 億元，較去年同期的 3.09 億元增加五成，生產線上的半成品也隨備料增加。
存貨去化速度同步放慢。第 3 季存貨週轉天數 127 天，高於 2025 年底的 121 天，也高於去年同期的 104 天。存貨金額是近 3 個月營收的 1.25 倍，2026 年 3 月底時為 0.98 倍。
備料對應後續交付需求，公司指出，第 3 季接單出貨比 1.6 倍，接單金額高於出貨金額，對第 4 季與 2027 年上半年的營運持正向看法。
交期拉長，備料先行料件交期也是此次備料的原因之一。公司表示，下半年出現 PCB 這類料件交期拉長的新狀況，料況變動大，客戶的訂單與出貨時點也仍在變動；針對已確認的訂單，公司整合安排關鍵料件的到料時間、生產排程與客戶交期。
因應方式是先掌握客戶的預測與訂單，搭配部分現貨採購，再與關鍵供應商溝通更長期間的需求預測，同時檢查料件的共通性與可能的呆滯風險。公司表示「現在的庫存管理其實難度比以前更高」。
負債增加，應收天數縮短存貨占用資金，應收帳款與應付帳款的變化則補足資金缺口。應收帳款週轉天數由 2025 年底的 74 天降至 63 天，加上存貨的 127 天、扣除應付帳款的 80 天，營運資金週轉天數為 110 天，低於 2025 年底的 117 天。
流動比率 134%，低於 2025 年底的 159%，也低於去年同期的 170%。
資產負債表中的流動負債也持續擴大，由 2025 年底的 46.36 億元增加至 81.52 億元，增加 35.16 億元，大於同期存貨增加的 22.44 億元。每股淨值 31.33 元。
這批原料能否轉為營收，取決於 2027 年上半年的交付。公司在同一場法說會上揭露第 3 季接單出貨比 1.6 倍、原料是去年同期的三倍，交付能否依排程進行，將決定這 47.61 億元存貨是交付準備還是資金壓力。

paras_en: November 12, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U‑Tong (2397‑TW) reported inventory of NT$4.761 billion at the end of Q3 2026, representing 30% of total assets, up 9 percentage points from 21% at the end of 2025. The company said at its earnings briefing that the inventory increase reflects a larger operating scale and preparation for future supply‑chain deliveries.

Almost all the newly raised capital was invested in raw materials. Raw material inventory in Q3 was NT$2.984 billion, 3.1 times the NT$961 million recorded in the same period last year, raising its share of total inventory from 41% to 63%.

As shown in the chart from U‑Analysis’s industry database, inventory rose from around NT$2.0 billion in 2024 to NT$4.76 billion by Q3 2026, with the increase almost entirely concentrated in the top‑most layer of raw materials, while finished goods grew only about 20%.
Source: U‑Analysis industry database

Finished goods and merchandise amounted to NT$1.222 billion, a 20% increase from NT$1.001 billion a year earlier; work‑in‑process inventory was NT$466 million, up 50% from NT$309 million a year earlier, as semi‑finished items on the production line also rose with material stocking.

The pace of inventory turnover slowed as well. Inventory turnover days in Q3 were 127 days, higher than 121 days at the end of 2025 and higher than 104 days in the same quarter last year. Inventory value equaled 1.25 times the revenue of the past three months, and was 0.98 times revenue as of the end of March 2026.

Prepared material to meet future delivery demand, the company noted that the order‑to‑shipment ratio in Q3 was 1.6 times, with order value exceeding shipment value, leading to a positive outlook for Q4 and the first half of 2027.

Delivery lead times have lengthened, and the extended lead time for pre‑stocked components is one reason for the current material stocking. The company said new situations such as longer PCB component lead times emerged in the second half of the year, causing significant material fluctuations and ongoing changes in customer order and shipment timing; for confirmed orders, the company coordinates key component arrival, production scheduling, and customer delivery dates.

The response is to capture customer forecasts and orders, supplement with spot purchases, communicate longer‑term demand forecasts with key suppliers, and examine component commonality and potential obsolescence risks. The company stated, “Current inventory management is actually more difficult than before.”

Debt has risen, while receivable days have shortened; inventory ties up capital, and changes in accounts receivable and payable fill the funding gap. Receivable turnover days fell from 74 days at the end of 2025 to 63 days, and together with 127 days of inventory and subtracting 80 days of payables, the operating cash‑conversion cycle is 110 days, down from 117 days at the end of 2025.
The current ratio is 134%, lower than 159% at the end of 2025 and lower than 170% in the same period last year.

Current liabilities on the balance sheet continued to expand, rising from NT$4.636 billion at the end of 2025 to NT$8.152 billion, an increase of NT$3.516 billion, exceeding the NT$2.244 billion rise in inventory over the same period. Net asset value per share is NT$31.33.

Whether this batch of raw materials can be turned into revenue depends on deliveries in the first half of 2027. In the same earnings briefing, the company disclosed a Q3 order‑to‑shipment ratio of 1.6 times and raw materials at three times last year’s level; the ability to deliver according to schedule will determine if the NT$4.761 billion inventory is a delivery preparation or a financial pressure.

items.title: 友通(2397) 毛利率連升兩季，為何前 3 季仍落後去年 1.6 個百分點？
items.title_en: Why Does Youtong (2397) Still Lag 1.6 Percentage Points Behind Last Year After Two Consecutive Seasons of Rising Gross Margin?
paras: 2026年11月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 友通(2397-TW) 2026 年第 3 季毛利率 26.2%，較第 2 季的 25.2% 增加 1 個百分點；前 3 季累計 25.5%，低於去年同期的 27.1%，減少 1.6 個百分點。
公司將累計毛利率下滑歸因於產品組合與材料成本上漲；累計 25.5% 與單季 26.2% 分別呈現累計期間與單一季度的表現，兩者對應的觀察期間不同。
從較長期間觀察，毛利率由 2024 年的 28.19% 降至 2025 年的 26.02%，2026 年第 1 季再降至 24.89%，第 2 季與第 3 季連續回升，第 3 季已高於 2025 年第 4 季的 25.36%，但仍低於 2025 年第 1 季的 28.9%。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，毛利率在 2024 年第 4 季達到高點後持續下滑，2026 年第 2 季起連兩季回升，第 3 季回到 26% 以上，仍低於 2024 年的高點。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
產品組合也在改變，2026 年前 3 季 Computer on Module（板卡模組）占營收 22%，低於 2025 年前 3 季的 25%，OT Service（智慧自動化的系統整合服務）占 42%，為占比最高的項目。營收比重轉向服務與系統，是公司從板卡延伸至工業級系統的結果；板卡提供設計與製造，系統則提供整合。
材料成本是公司指出的另一個變數。公司在法說會上提到供應鏈交期延長、部分料件變動大，也提到為長交期需求提前備料，對已確認的訂單預先安排關鍵料件的到料時間與生產排程。提前備料有助於掌握交付時間，資金與料價壓力則反映在成本中。材料成本變化不會呈現在產品組合中，兩者須分別觀察。
單季與累計方向相反單季的毛利成長快於營收，第 3 季營收年增 44%，營業毛利年增 49%，毛利率因此較去年同期增加 0.9 個百分點。
若觀察前 3 季累計數字，走勢則相反：營業毛利年增 24%、營收年增 32%，毛利成長速度低於營收，累計毛利率因此落後去年。
單季 26.2% 是連兩季回升的結果，前 3 季 25.5% 仍低於 2025 年全年的 26.02%。材料成本的上漲幅度，將決定第 4 季毛利率能否延續回升走勢。產品組合轉向系統與服務的速度，將決定 2027 年毛利率的上升空間；兩項因素在第 4 季都尚未有結果。

paras_en: November 12, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Youtong (2397‑TW) posted a Q3 2026 gross margin of 26.2%, up 1 percentage point from the 25.2% recorded in Q2. The cumulative gross margin for the first three quarters was 25.5%, below the 27.1% achieved in the same period last year, a decline of 1.6 percentage points.

The company attributes the cumulative margin decline to a shift in product mix and rising material costs; the 25.5% cumulative figure and the 26.2% single‑quarter figure reflect performance over different observation periods.

Looking at a longer horizon, the gross margin fell from 28.19% in 2024 to 26.02% in 2025, dropped further to 24.89% in Q1 2026, then rose in Q2 and Q3, with Q3 surpassing the 25.36% recorded in Q4 2025 but still below the 28.9% seen in Q1 2025.

As shown in the chart from U‑Analysis’s industry database, the margin peaked in Q4 2024 and then declined continuously, turning upward in Q2 2026 and staying above 26% in Q3, yet remaining below the 2024 high.
Source: U‑Analysis Industry Database

The product mix is also changing. In the first three quarters of 2026, Computer on Module (COM) accounted for 22% of revenue, down from 25% in the same period of 2025, while OT Service (intelligent automation system‑integration services) made up 42%, the largest share. The shift toward services and systems reflects the company’s move from board‑level products to industrial‑grade systems; boards provide design and manufacturing, while systems deliver integration.

Material cost is the other variable highlighted by the company. In its earnings briefing, Youtong mentioned longer supply‑chain lead times and significant price swings for certain components, and explained that it pre‑positions key materials for confirmed orders to meet long‑lead‑time demand. Early stocking helps secure delivery schedules, but the associated capital and price pressures show up in costs. Material‑cost changes do not appear in the product‑mix breakdown and must be examined separately.

For the single‑quarter view, margin growth outpaced revenue growth. In Q3, revenue rose 44% year‑over‑year, operating gross profit rose 49% year‑over‑year, and the margin therefore improved by 0.9 percentage points versus the same quarter last year.

When looking at the cumulative figures for the first three quarters, the trend reverses: operating gross profit grew 24% year‑over‑year while revenue grew 32%, so margin growth lagged revenue growth, leaving the cumulative margin behind last year’s level.

The 26.2% margin for the quarter is the result of two consecutive quarters of improvement, but the 25.5% cumulative margin for the first three quarters remains below the full‑year 2025 margin of 26.02%. The extent of material‑cost increases will determine whether the Q4 margin can continue the upward trend. The speed at which the product mix shifts toward systems and services will shape the margin upside potential in 2027; neither factor has produced a result for Q4 yet.

items.title: 友通(2397) 營業利益翻倍不是靠刪費用！研發支出反增七成五
items.title_en: Youtong (2397) Doubles Operating Profit Not by Cutting Costs! R&D Spending Jumps 75%
paras: 2026年11月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 友通(2397-TW) 2026 年第 3 季營業利益 2.93 億元，較去年同期的 1.47 億元增加一倍，營業利益率由 5.5% 升到 7.7%；獲利大幅成長的直接來源是營收成長快於費用。
第 3 季營收年增 44%，營業費用年增 35%，營收成長快於費用，營業費用率因此由去年同期的 19.8% 降到 18.5%。費用金額實際上仍增加，營收成長則稀釋了費用率。
營收成長來自三大事業同步成長。嵌入式事業取得機器人與半導體及工業設備客戶的專案，網路安全事業提高中高階產品的比重，智慧自動化受惠於設備升級與智慧製造需求；公司在法說會上將此形容為三大事業營收同步成長。
三項費用率也出現變化，推銷費用率由去年同期的 9.65% 降到 7.73%，管理費用率由 4.93% 降到 4.03%，研發費用率由 5.49% 升到 6.66%。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，推銷費用率從 2023 年底的 11% 降到 2026 年第 3 季的 7.73%，研發費用率反向升到 6.66%，兩條線在最近一季靠攏。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
研發費用是金額增加最多的項目，第 3 季 2.54 億元，較去年同期的 1.45 億元增加七成五，研發費用率 6.66% 是 2024 年第 2 季以來最高，推銷與管理費用率則同時落在同期最低。研發投入與營收規模同步擴大，兩者對費用率的影響方向相反；單季研發費用率仍提高，營收成長未能完全稀釋研發投入。
累計表現尚未同步改善，前 3 季營業利益 7.47 億元、年增 32%，營業利益率 7.1%，與去年同期相同，單季的大幅成長尚未累積成整年的差距。
毛利率抵銷費用改善前 3 季營業費用率由 20.0% 降到 18.4%，改善的 1.6 個百分點，被毛利率下滑的 1.6 個百分點抵銷，累計營業利益率因此維持不變。
推銷費用的變化呈現營收規模擴大的作用，推銷費用金額較去年同期增加一成五，費用率卻減少 1.9 個百分點，營收成長把這筆費用攤薄。
研發費用的方向與平台開發同步，公司表示 NVIDIA 各平台正在推進開發與概念驗證，為 2027 年的導入做準備，從板卡延伸到工業級系統時，會結合晶片、軟體與集團資源。
單季 7.7% 的營業利益率，來自營收規模與費用率同時改善；累計 7.1% 與去年持平，反映前 3 季毛利率下滑抵銷了費用率改善。研發費用已先行增加，2027 年的導入能否進一步推升營收，將決定這筆費用最終能否獲得攤薄，或持續構成負擔。

paras_en: November 12, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Youtong (2397‑TW) posted operating profit of NT$293 million for Q3 2026, exactly double the NT$147 million a year earlier, with the operating margin rising from 5.5% to 7.7%. The sharp profit growth came directly from revenue increasing faster than expenses.

Revenue grew 44% year‑over‑year in Q3, while operating expenses rose 35%, so revenue outpaced cost growth and the operating expense ratio fell from 19.8% a year ago to 18.5% this quarter. The expense amount still rose, but the higher revenue diluted the expense ratio.

Revenue growth came from simultaneous expansion across three core businesses. The embedded systems unit secured projects with robotics, semiconductor and industrial equipment customers, the network security unit increased the share of mid‑to‑high‑end products, and the smart automation unit benefited from equipment upgrades and smart‑manufacturing demand; the company described this as synchronized revenue growth across its three main segments at the earnings briefing.

All three expense ratios changed as well: selling expense ratio dropped from 9.65% a year ago to 7.73%, management expense ratio fell from 4.93% to 4.03%, while R&D expense ratio rose from 5.49% to 6.66%.

As shown in the chart from U‑Analysis’s industry database, the selling expense ratio fell from 11% at the end of 2023 to 7.73% in Q3 2026, while the R&D expense ratio climbed back up to 6.66%, with the two lines converging in the most recent quarter.
(Source: U‑Analysis industry database)

R&D spending was the item with the largest absolute increase, reaching NT$254 million in Q3, up 75% from NT$145 million a year earlier. The 6.66% R&D expense ratio is the highest since Q2 2024, while selling and management expense ratios hit their lowest levels for the same period. R&D investment expanded in line with revenue scale, exerting opposite pressure on the expense ratios; the single‑quarter R&D ratio still rose because revenue growth did not fully offset the added R&D spend.

Cumulative performance has not yet caught up: operating profit for the first three quarters totaled NT$747 million, up 32% year‑over‑year, with an operating margin of 7.1%, unchanged from the same period last year. The strong single‑quarter gain has not yet translated into a full‑year gap.

Gross margin offset the expense improvement: operating expense ratio fell from 20.0% to 18.4% in the first three quarters, a 1.6‑percentage‑point improvement that was neutralized by a 1.6‑percentage‑point decline in gross margin, leaving the cumulative operating margin unchanged.

The change in selling expenses reflects the effect of larger revenue scale: the selling expense amount rose 15% year‑over‑year, but the ratio fell by 1.9 percentage points, as revenue growth diluted the cost.

R&D spending aligns with platform development; the company said NVIDIA’s various platforms are being advanced and validated in preparation for a 2027 rollout, and when extending from board‑level products to industrial‑grade systems, they will integrate chips, software and group resources.

The 7.7% operating margin for the quarter stems from simultaneous improvements in revenue scale and expense ratios; the cumulative 7.1% margin, flat with last year, reflects that the first‑three‑quarters gross‑margin decline offset the expense‑ratio gains. Whether the 2027 rollout can further lift revenue will determine if the upfront R&D spend can eventually be amortized or will remain a burden.

items.title: 友通(2397) 邊緣 AI 潛在商機九成集中三大應用，訂單轉化看驗證複製速度
items.title_en: Youtong (2397) Edge AI Potential Opportunities 90% Concentrated in Three Major Applications, Order Conversion Depends on Validation Replication Speed
paras: 2026年11月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 友通(2397-TW) 在法說會上將邊緣 AI 機會分為三大應用：工業自動化占 42.4%，半導體與工業設備 29.7%，關鍵任務型應用 19.4%。這三個比重為公司追蹤的工業級邊緣 AI 潛在商機占比，三項合計 91.5%。
這三大應用對應設備端算力需求。公司指出，各國持續投資在地製造與半導體，新建工廠與產線導入自動化，算力需求要在設備現場建置完成；移動機器人的視覺辨識、導航與避障，產線上的即時瑕疵檢測，都須在現場完成處理後再做出下一個反應。
SEMI（國際半導體產業協會）預估 2026 年全球半導體製造設備銷售額 1,659 億美元、年增 23.2%，公司關注的是這些投資帶來的設備端運算需求。
公司也註明，潛在商機不代表訂單或營收，三大應用以外的其他應用占 8.5%。
先算需求再挑平台公司選擇平台時先計算需求，以半導體製程設備為例，先確認設備要處理多少影像、須在多久內做出判斷，再評估現場介面、可用功耗與散熱條件，最後才建議運算平台。公司稱此做法為「最適算力」。
每台設備完成驗證後，公司會保留運算架構、介面設計與測試方法，同一個客戶的其他產品線、或同產業的新客戶可以縮短開發與驗證週期；需要更完整的整合時，公司從板卡延伸到工業級系統，結合晶片、軟體與母公司佳世達的集團資源。
應用分布於不同產業，日本為半導體的自動光學檢測（AOI），韓國有智慧軌道交通與醫美專案，印度為手術機器人控制，美國包括醫療滅菌、人機介面與衛星通訊。
營收亦持續成長，2026 年前 10 月營收 117.25 億元、年增 30.8%，10 月單月 11.68 億元，月減 9.8%、年增 22.76%，10 月的年增率是今年 3 月以來最低。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，月營收年增率連兩個月下滑，8 月 48.01%、9 月 34.24%、10 月 22.76%，累計年增率 30.78% 仍高於三成，單月與累計出現落差。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
三大應用商機屬於公司追蹤範圍，能否轉為訂單，取決於驗證經驗複製至同產業新客戶的速度。前 3 季營收 105.57 億元、年增 32%，應用別以智慧自動化占營收 42% 最高；驗證經驗的複製速度，將決定 91.5% 的商機有多少能轉化為訂單。

paras_en: On November 12, 2026 (reported by You Analysis/Industry Data Center), Youtong (2397‑TW) divided edge AI opportunities at its earnings conference into three major applications: industrial automation accounting for 42.4%, semiconductors and industrial equipment 29.7%, and critical mission‑type applications 19.4%. These three shares represent the company’s tracked industrial‑grade edge AI potential, together comprising 91.5% of the total.

These three applications correspond to computing power demand on the equipment side. The company noted that countries continue to invest in local manufacturing and semiconductors, with new factories and production lines adopting automation, requiring computing power to be installed on‑site; visual recognition, navigation and obstacle avoidance for mobile robots, as well as real‑time defect detection on production lines, must also be processed locally before the next action is taken.

SEMI (the International Semiconductor Industry Association) forecasts global semiconductor manufacturing equipment sales of $165.9 billion in 2026, up 23.2% year‑over‑year. The company is focused on the computing demand generated by these investments on the equipment side.
The company also clarified that potential opportunities do not equate to orders or revenue, and applications outside the three major categories account for 8.5%.

First calculate demand, then select the platform. When choosing a platform, the company first quantifies demand. For example, for semiconductor process equipment, it first determines how many images the equipment must process and within what time a decision must be made, then evaluates the on‑site interface, available power consumption and thermal conditions, and finally recommends a computing platform. The company calls this approach “optimal computing power.”

After each piece of equipment completes validation, the company retains the computing architecture, interface design and test methods. Other product lines of the same customer, or new customers in the same industry, can thus shorten development and validation cycles. When more comprehensive integration is needed, the company extends from board‑level to industrial‑grade systems, combining chips, software and the group resources of its parent, JASDAQ.

The applications span different regions: Japan focuses on semiconductor automatic optical inspection (AOI), Korea on smart rail transit and medical‑aesthetic projects, India on surgical robot control, and the United States on medical sterilization, human‑machine interfaces and satellite communications.

Revenue continues to grow, with October 2026 revenue reaching NT$11.725 billion, up 30.8% year‑over‑year. October’s single‑month revenue was NT$1.168 billion, down 9.8% month‑over‑month but up 22.76% year‑over‑year, marking the lowest annual growth rate since March this year.

As shown in the chart from You Analysis’s industry database, the month‑over‑month revenue growth rate fell for two consecutive months: 48.01% in August, 34.24% in September and 22.76% in October, while the cumulative annual growth rate remains at 30.78%, still above 30%, creating a gap between monthly and cumulative figures.
(Source: You Analysis industry database)

The three major application opportunities are within the company’s tracking scope; whether they convert to orders depends on how quickly validation experience can be replicated for new customers in the same industry. In the first three quarters, revenue was NT$10.557 billion, up 32% year‑over‑year, with smart automation accounting for the highest share at 42% of revenue. The speed of replicating validation experience will determine how much of the 91.5% opportunity pool can be turned into orders.

items.title: 友通(2397) 機器人首案已出貨！第三案採 NVIDIA Thor，預計 2027 年第 3 季量產
items.title_en: Youtong (2397) Ships First Robot Project; Third Project Uses NVIDIA Thor, Mass Production Planned for Q3 2027
paras: 2026年11月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 友通(2397-TW) 歐美品牌客戶的機器人專案已進展至第三案。公司指出，第一案已量產出貨，第二案將在第 2 季量產，第三案採用 NVIDIA 的 Thor 平台，預計第 3 季進入量產。法說會在 2026 年 11 月舉行，按時間推算，這兩個季度對應 2027 年的第 2 季與第 3 季。
這些專案來自同一組歐美品牌客戶，提供機器手臂與移動機器人的整機方案。公司表示，客戶產品從設計到量產，除了設計與驗證，供應鏈選擇、料況與後續製造也須同步配合。
Thor 平台是 NVIDIA 為機器人與邊緣 AI 推論設計的運算平台。公司表示，NVIDIA 的各平台正在推進開發與概念驗證，是「做明年後續導入的這個準備」；換算成西元年，這些導入落在 2027 年。
平台不只一個AMD、Intel 與 NVIDIA 的平台各有不同的算力與定位，對應的工作負載亦不同。公司依客戶的應用、軟體成熟度、功耗與整體成本提出建議，提案前會先取得晶片廠在長期供貨上的承諾，Intel 與 AMD 均曾提供這類承諾。
客戶最在意的價值是長期供貨。公司表示，這一兩年收到較多商機詢問，原因在於長期供貨與品質保證；軌道交通這類設備使用多年，客戶在設計階段就須考量料件能否長期供應，以及維護週期如何配合。
應用已分布於不同產業，日本為半導體的自動光學檢測，韓國有智慧軌道交通與醫美，印度為手術機器人控制，美國包括醫療滅菌、人機介面與衛星通訊；智慧交通上，公司近期與一家 Tier 1 廠商合作，將對方的資安能力整合至車載邊緣 AI 方案。
合約負債先增加訂單金額先反映於資產負債表。第 3 季合約負債 3.76 億元，為客戶預先支付、尚未認列營收的款項，占 38.19 億元季營收的 9.85%，去年同期是 1.09 億元、4.1%。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，合約負債的金額從 2024 年的 1 億元上下增加到 2026 年第 3 季的接近 4 億元，占季營收比重在 2025 年前 3 季都在 5% 以下，第 4 季升到 6.6%，2026 年三季都在 8% 以上。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
交付仍存在變數。公司指出，第 3 季接單出貨比 1.6 倍，接單金額高於出貨金額，長交期料件、生產排程與客戶交期須整合安排，對第 4 季與 2027 年上半年的營運持正向看法。
開案到量產之間的驗證與料件準備，集中在 2026 年到 2027 年上半年，此期間的交付排程，將決定 3.76 億元預收款認列為營收的時間。

paras_en: On November 12, 2026 (Yuan Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Youtong (2397‑TW) has progressed its European‑American brand customer’s robot projects to the third case. The company said the first case has entered mass production and shipment, the second case will begin mass production in Q2, and the third case will use NVIDIA’s Thor platform, expected to enter mass production in Q3. The earnings conference will be held in November 2026, which corresponds to Q2 and Q3 of 2027.

These projects come from the same group of European‑American brand customers and provide complete solutions for robotic arms and mobile robots. The company noted that from design to mass production, the customer’s product requires coordination of design and verification, supply‑chain selection, material status, and subsequent manufacturing.

The Thor platform is NVIDIA’s compute platform designed for robot and edge AI inference. The company said NVIDIA’s various platforms are advancing development and proof‑of‑concept, which is “preparation for next‑year’s subsequent adoption”; in Gregorian terms, these adoptions fall in 2027.

There is not just one platform – AMD, Intel and NVIDIA each have different compute power and positioning, with corresponding workloads. The company offers recommendations based on the customer’s application, software maturity, power consumption and overall cost, and secures long‑term supply commitments from chip makers before proposing; both Intel and AMD have provided such commitments.

The customer’s top concern is long‑term supply. The company said it has received more business inquiries in the past one‑to‑two years because of long‑term supply and quality guarantees; equipment such as rail‑based transport is used for many years, so customers must consider during design whether parts can be supplied long‑term and how maintenance cycles align.

Applications are spread across industries: Japan for semiconductor automatic optical inspection, South Korea for smart rail transport and medical aesthetics, India for surgical robot control, and the United States for medical sterilization, human‑machine interfaces and satellite communications. In smart transportation, the company recently partnered with a Tier‑1 supplier to integrate the partner’s cybersecurity capabilities into an in‑vehicle edge‑AI solution.

Contract liabilities first increase as order amounts are reflected on the balance sheet. Contract liabilities in Q3 were NT$376 million, representing customer pre‑payments not yet recognized as revenue, accounting for 9.85% of the quarter’s NT$3.819 billion revenue; last year’s same period was NT$109 million, 4.1%.

As shown in the figure, according to Yuan Analysis’s industry database, contract liabilities rose from around NT$100 million in 2024 to nearly NT$400 million in Q3 2026, representing a share of quarterly revenue that was below 5% in the first three quarters of 2025, rose to 6.6% in Q4, and stayed above 8% in all three quarters of 2026.
Source: Yuan Analysis industry database

Delivery still has variables. The company noted that in Q3 the order‑to‑shipment ratio was 1.6 times, with order value exceeding shipment value; long‑lead‑time materials, production scheduling and customer delivery dates need integrated planning, and the outlook for Q4 and the first half of 2027 remains positive.

The verification and material preparation between project launch and mass production are concentrated in 2026 to the first half of 2027; the delivery schedule during this period will determine when the NT$376 million of prepaid amounts are recognized as revenue.

items.title: 美晶片出口管制沒用！中國大學持續取得輝達高階AI晶片
items.title_en: US Chip Export Controls Ineffective! Chinese Universities Continue to Acquire Nvidia's High-End AI Chips
paras: 《路透》報導，與中國解放軍關係密切的西北工業大學，雖已被美國列入出口管制實體清單，仍在 10 月透過中國供應商購入兩顆輝達 (NVDA-US) H200 人工智慧 (AI) 晶片，總價人民幣 87 萬 4,700 元，約 12.3 萬美元，該校今年另簽下五份算力租賃合約，取得搭載 H200 等受管制晶片的伺服器使用權，凸顯華府除了審查出口對象，也面臨晶片轉售及算力服務的監管難題。
《路透》查閱西北工業大學 10 月 21 日公布的採購紀錄發現，這兩顆 H200 由該校管理學院向陝西博算網路科技採購，交易對手為中國本地供應商。
西北工業大學位於西安，是中國「國防七子」之一，研究涵蓋軍用飛機、飛彈與衛星。美國商務部 2001 年將該校列入實體清單，2019 年進一步收緊限制，多數受管制技術的出口許可申請原則上不予核准。
該校網路安全學院今年 1 月另簽下兩份為期七個月的算力合約，每份均可使用搭載八顆 H200 的伺服器，金額分別為人民幣 44 萬 1,700 元及 44 萬 1,000 元，用於 AI 模型微調及強化學習訓練。
該校另一個研究單位 4 月也以人民幣 37 萬 5,000 元採購運算服務，要求至少使用 24 顆輝達 A100 晶片，供結構與流體力學模擬使用。
公開紀錄列出採購方、本地供應商與部分合約用途，但晶片最初如何進入中國、出租伺服器設在何處，仍有待釐清。
多所中國高校取得受管制晶片
類似交易也出現在其他高校。
深圳大學 9 月以人民幣 76 萬 9,800 元購入三顆 H100。武漢理工大學 6 月以人民幣 35 萬 5,000 元採購一台搭載 H100 的伺服器，另以人民幣 34 萬 4,000 元購入四顆 A100。
同屬「國防七子」的北京航空航天大學則在 4 月以人民幣 48 萬 9,000 元採購四顆 A800。
川普政府今年 1 月起，對符合條件的 H200 對中出口申請改採個案審查，實體清單上的機構仍受原有的終端使用者限制。
新規也要求收貨方查核客戶身分，防止未獲授權的對象遠端使用晶片。
美國國會兩黨議員正推動晶片追蹤措施及加強國會對出口許可的監督。
輝達執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 則主張，持續向中國銷售晶片，有助維持美國的技術領先地位，並讓中國客戶繼續使用美國技術。
輝達先前在財報中揭露，儘管美方自 2 月起核准向特定中國客戶少量出口 H200，北京的限制使實際出貨僅達美方核准數量的一小部分。輝達已在 2027 會計年度上半年認列 4 億美元的 H200 相關費用，涉及過剩庫存與採購承諾。依輝達當時的申報，許可計畫下的 H200 出貨占該季資料中心營收不到 1%。
Baird 分析師 Tristan Gerra 將輝達評等下調至「中立」，理由包括美國政府調查、營收風險及黃仁勳能否續任的不確定性。
Gerra 指出，若華府重新禁止 H200 對中出口，輝達可能面臨約 50 億美元的資產減記。他也預期，美方可能收緊對東南亞資料中心的出口管制，以減少受管制晶片經第三地流入中國的風險。
受黃仁勳婚外情風波牽連，AI巨頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 已連續重挫兩個交易日，週三 (11日) 逢低買盤回流，股價收紅2.92% 至每股173.73 美元，今年以來累計下滑 8%。
paras_en: Reuters reported that Northwestern Polytechnical University, which has close ties to the Chinese People’s Liberation Army and is already on the U.S. export‑control entity list, bought two Nvidia (NVDA-US) H200 artificial‑intelligence chips in October through a Chinese supplier for a total of RMB 874,700 (about $123,000). The university also signed five compute‑capacity leasing contracts this year to obtain server access that includes H200 and other restricted chips, highlighting that Washington faces not only export‑to‑entity scrutiny but also challenges regulating chip resale and compute‑as‑a‑service.

The Reuters review of Northwestern Polytechnical University’s procurement record dated 21 October shows that the two H200 chips were purchased by the university’s School of Management from Shaanxi BoSuan Network Technology, a domestic Chinese supplier.

Northwestern Polytechnical University, located in Xi’an, is one of China’s “Seven Defense Universities” and conducts research on military aircraft, missiles and satellites. The U.S. Department of Commerce added the school to the Entity List in 2001 and tightened restrictions in 2019, generally denying export licences for most controlled technologies.

In January this year, the university’s School of Cybersecurity signed two seven‑month compute contracts, each granting access to a server equipped with eight H200 chips, for RMB 441,700 and RMB 441,000 respectively, to be used for AI model fine‑tuning and reinforcement‑learning training.
Another research unit at the university purchased computing services in April for RMB 375,000, requiring the use of at least 24 Nvidia A100 chips for structural and fluid‑mechanics simulations.

Public records list the purchaser, the domestic supplier and parts of the contract purpose, but it remains unclear how the chips originally entered China and where the leased servers are physically located.
Several Chinese universities have obtained restricted chips.
Similar transactions have appeared at other universities.

Shenzhen University bought three H100 chips in September for RMB 769,800. Wuhan University of Technology purchased a server with an H100 in June for RMB 355,000 and bought four A100 chips for RMB 344,000.
Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, also a “Seven Defense University,” bought four A800 chips in April for RMB 489,000.
Since January, the Trump administration has shifted to case‑by‑case review for eligible H200 exports to China, while entities on the Entity List remain subject to the original end‑user restrictions.
The new rules also require the recipient to verify the customer’s identity to prevent unauthorized remote use of the chips.
Bipartisan members of Congress are pushing chip‑tracking measures and stronger congressional oversight of export licences.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argues that continuing to sell chips to China helps maintain U.S. technological leadership and allows Chinese customers to keep using U.S. technology.

Nvidia disclosed in its earnings that, although the U.S. approved limited H200 shipments to certain Chinese customers starting in February, Beijing’s restrictions meant actual shipments were only a small fraction of the approved amount. Nvidia recorded $400 million of H200‑related expenses in the first half of fiscal 2027, tied to excess inventory and purchase commitments. Under the licence programme, H200 shipments accounted for less than 1% of the quarter’s data‑center revenue.
Baird analyst Tristan Gerra downgraded Nvidia to a “Neutral” rating, citing U.S. government investigations, revenue risk and uncertainty over Jensen Huang’s tenure.

Gerra noted that if Washington re‑bans H200 exports to China, Nvidia could face roughly $5 billion of asset write‑downs. He also expects the U.S. may tighten export controls on Southeast Asian data centres to reduce the risk of restricted chips flowing to China via third‑party locations.

Affected by Jensen Huang’s extramarital‑affair scandal, AI giant Nvidia (NVDA-US) has fallen for two consecutive trading days; on Wednesday (the 11th) buying pressure returned, lifting the stock 2.92% to $173.73 per share, down 8% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉CoreWeave點燃AI買盤 輝達終止連二跌 費半勁揚超5.6%
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: CoreWeave Ignites AI Buying, Nvidia Stops Two-Day Decline, Philly Semiconductor Index Jumps Over 5.6%
paras: 美股週三 (11 日) 四大指數收高，AI 雲端業者 CoreWeave 第三季營收優於預期，並上調全年財測，股價飆漲近 25%，帶動 AI 概念股反彈。輝達結束連兩日跌勢，那斯達克指數上漲 1.60%，費城半導體指數勁揚 5.66%。
CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 上調 2026 年營收與營業利益展望，緩解市場對 AI 基礎設施需求的疑慮。
AI 新創 Anthropic 也在更新的申報文件中表示，計畫於下週首次公開募股 (IPO)，擬發行 8.25 億股，估值最高可達 1.4 兆美元。這筆 IPO 已獲超額認購，OpenAI 單季營收則達 100 億美元。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 週三止跌回升，執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 坦承婚外情後，輝達本週前兩個交易日累跌近 10%。兩名共和黨籍眾議員週三表示，國會已準備傳喚黃仁勳，就這段關係提供說明。
通膨數據仍牽動利率預期。美國 10 月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 月增 0.4%，高於市場預期。
芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比 (Austan Goolsbee) 形容，這份通膨報告再度令人憂心。聯準會 (Fed) 理事華勒 (Christopher Waller) 週二的談話，也推升市場對 12 月升息的預期。
芝商所 (CME) FedWatch 工具顯示，數據公布後，市場估計 12 月升息一碼的機率升至約九成。
美債現貨市場週三因退伍軍人節休市，美債期貨小幅走低，美元觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最高水準。
美股週三 (11 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 下跌 1.97%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 2.04%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 2.11%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.26%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 1.74%。
半導體指標股齊揚。AMD (AMD-US) 飆漲 7.32%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 3.99%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 2.87%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 飆漲 6.05%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.75%。
記憶體與儲存族群全面走高。美光 (MU-US) 狂升 11.89%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 暴漲 8.34%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 瘋漲 13.69%；希捷 (STX-US) 飆漲 9.99%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 狂飆 9.71%。
台股 ADR 全數收紅。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 大漲 4.25%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 猛升 6.60%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 大漲 6.91%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 微漲 0.45%。
企業新聞
CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 飆漲超 24% 至每股 60.77 美元，創2025年6月以來最強單日表現。 這家 AI 雲端業者公布亮眼的第三季財報，緩解市場對其資產負債表的疑慮。執行長英特雷特 (Michael Intrator) 表示，公司將停止在公開市場發行無擔保債券，改採過去曾使用、可在約定期限內按需提款的貸款額度。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 週三上漲 2.87%，收報 173.73 美元。投資機構 Baird 同日將輝達評等由「優於大盤」下調至「中立」，並呼籲黃仁勳辭任執行長。黃仁勳坦承與一名被指涉嫌替中國從事間諜活動的女子有婚外情後，華爾街對他的去留日益感到不安。
Nebius (NBIS-US) 飛漲逾 15% 至每股 154.69 美元。同為 AI 雲端業者的 Nebius 受到 CoreWeave 財報激勵，將於週四美股開盤前公布第三季財報。
好市多 (COST-US) 走升約 2% 至每股 1,087.61 美元。 這家倉儲式零售商宣布發放每股 30 美元的特別股息，為上一次特別股息的兩倍。董事會也重新授權 40 億美元的庫藏股計畫。
華爾街分析
貝爾德私人財富管理投資策略師 Ross Mayfield 表示，CoreWeave 財報與 Anthropic IPO 的認購需求改善了整個 AI 產業鏈的投資氣氛。上週賣壓消化後，市場正收復部分失地，許多 AI 股的短期估值與獲利前景也重新吸引買盤。
貝萊德全球固定收益投資長 Rick Rieder 研判，通膨仍高於 Fed 希望看到的水準，12 月升息是貝萊德與市場的基本預期，接下來的焦點是升息幅度。
摩根大通資產管理全球策略師 David Kelly 則認為，即使最新 CPI 高於預期，Fed 也沒有必要在 12 月升息兩碼。
