paras_en: U.S. stocks on Wednesday (the 11th) saw all four major indexes close higher. AI cloud provider CoreWeave posted third‑quarter revenue that beat expectations and raised its full‑year outlook, sending its shares up nearly 25% and sparking a rebound in AI‑related stocks. Nvidia ended a two‑day losing streak, the Nasdaq rose 1.60%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged 5.66%.
CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) lifted its 2026 revenue and operating‑income forecasts, easing market concerns about demand for AI infrastructure.

AI startup Anthropic disclosed in a filing that it plans an initial public offering next week, aiming to sell 825 million shares and valuing the company at up to $1.4 trillion. The IPO has already been oversubscribed, and OpenAI reported quarterly revenue of $10 billion.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) halted its decline on Wednesday and moved higher. CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, after which Nvidia had fallen nearly 10% over the prior two trading sessions. Two Republican members of Congress said on Wednesday that the House is prepared to summon Huang for an explanation of the relationship.
Inflation data continues to drive interest‑rate expectations. U.S. consumer price index (CPI) for October rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, above market forecasts.

Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee described the inflation report as again worrisome. Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks on Tuesday also lifted market expectations for a rate hike in December.
The CME FedWatch tool showed that after the data release, the market’s probability of a one‑point rate increase in December rose to roughly 90%.
U.S. Treasury spot markets were closed on Wednesday for Veterans Day, and Treasury futures slipped slightly while the dollar reached its highest level since May 2025.
U.S. stock market performance on Wednesday (the 11th):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 254.60 points, or 0.49%, to 52,486.49.
The Nasdaq Composite gained 400.31 points, or 1.60%, to 25,466.19.
The S&P 500 added 98.45 points, or 1.31%, to 7,619.38.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 565.78 points, or 5.66%, to 10,564.11.
The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 310.80 points, or 1.80%, to 17,585.25.

Focus stocks:
Among the five big‑tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index, gains and losses were mixed. Meta (META‑US) fell 1.97%; Apple (AAPL‑US) rose 2.04%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) climbed 2.11%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) dropped 2.26%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) slipped 1.74%.

Semiconductor bellwethers all rallied. AMD (AMD‑US) surged 7.32%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) rose 3.99%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) climbed 2.87%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) jumped 6.05%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) gained 1.75%.

Memory and storage stocks moved higher across the board. Micron (MU‑US) surged 11.89%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) leapt 8.34%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) rocketed 13.69%; Seagate (STX‑US) rose 9.99%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) spiked 9.71%.
All Taiwan‑related ADRs closed in the green. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) jumped 4.25%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) surged 6.60%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) rose 6.91%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) edged up 0.45%.
Company news:

CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) rocketed more than 24% to $60.77 per share, marking its strongest single‑day gain since June 2025. The AI cloud provider posted an impressive third‑quarter report that eased balance‑sheet concerns. CEO Michael Intrater said the company will stop issuing unsecured bonds in the public market and will instead rely on a loan facility previously used that allows drawdowns on demand within a set term.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) rose 2.87% on Wednesday, closing at $173.73. Investment firm Baird downgraded Nvidia that day from "outperform" to "neutral" and called for Jensen Huang to step down as CEO. After Huang admitted an affair with a woman alleged to have spied for China, Wall Street’s confidence in his leadership has waned.

Nebius (NBIS‑US) surged over 15% to $154.69 per share. The AI cloud competitor Nebius, buoyed by CoreWeave’s earnings, will release its own third‑quarter results before the U.S. market opens on Thursday.

Costco (COST‑US) climbed about 2% to $1,087.61 per share. The warehouse retailer announced a special dividend of $30 per share, double the previous special dividend, and the board re‑authorized a $4 billion share‑repurchase program.
Wall Street analysis:

Ross Mayfield, investment strategist at Baird Private Wealth Management, said CoreWeave’s earnings and the demand for Anthropic’s IPO have improved sentiment across the AI supply chain. After last week’s selling pressure was absorbed, the market is recapturing ground, and many AI stocks’ short‑term valuations and earnings outlooks are once again attracting buyers.

Rick Rieder, global fixed‑income chief investment officer at BlackRock, judged that inflation remains above the level the Fed wants to see, making a December rate hike the baseline expectation for BlackRock and the market, with the focus now on the size of the hike.
David Kelly, global strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, argued that even though the latest CPI came in hotter than expected, the Fed does not need to raise rates by two points in December.
All figures are updated as of the deadline; please refer to actual market quotes for final numbers.

items.title: 471億美元！川普點名以色列等六國為伊朗戰事買單　分析人士：政治姿態難兌現
items.title_en: $47.1 Billion! Trump Names Israel and Six Other Nations to Pay for the Iran War – Analysts Say the Political Gesture Is Hard to Fulfill
paras: 美國期中選舉慘敗後第三天，總統川普在電視節目中首次點名以色列、沙烏地阿拉伯、阿聯、卡達、巴林和科威特，要求它們「100%」償還美國在伊朗戰事中的開支。他說：「我們會把那些錢全部拿回來，因為如果沒有我們，它們根本不會存在。」根據五角大廈估算，截至10月16日，伊朗戰事成本達471億美元。
多位中東問題分析人士判斷，這更接近政治信號，而非可執行的政策。查塔姆研究所專家表示，川普的話最好被理解為政治姿態；科威特大學學者則稱這番話面向美國國內民眾，波斯灣國家也會這樣理解。分析師還說，川普在期中選舉後正尋找替罪羊，轉移對敗選的注意力。
歷史上，1991年波斯灣戰爭後的成本分攤因有聯合國授權而實現，而2026年伊朗戰事由美以聯合發動，波斯灣國家事先未被充分告知，兩者性質不可比。
波斯灣國家處境最為矛盾。它們不是戰爭發起方，卻承受伊朗報復性打擊的主要衝擊。沙烏地阿拉伯今年第三季度預算赤字達224億美元，卡達液化天然氣設施遭襲致年收入損失約200億美元。
安聯貿易評估，波斯灣合作委員會(GCC)今年GDP將萎縮4%，累計損失未來產出約7900億美元。在此財政狀況下，要求再付471億美元幾乎不可，波斯灣國家料將「悄悄抵制」，辯稱已通過防務合作、基地支持等付過帳，替代補償形式如投資、軍購等，本質是將既有事務重新包裝。
以色列是新變量。尼坦雅胡對要求保持沉默，背景是川普宣布年底前停止對以每年約40億美元軍援。尼坦雅胡曾提出未來十年將軍援降至零。川普雙重施壓：切斷未來援助並追討過去成本。但471億美元對以色列同樣缺乏依據，美國自1991年後從未要求以色列「償還」費用。
分析人士認為，川普開出帳單未必真正落實，波斯灣國家和以色列清楚這是政治姿態，回應方式將是等待其注意力轉移到下一個目標上。
paras_en: Three days after his disastrous midterm election loss, President Trump on a TV show for the first time singled out Israel, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait, demanding they "100%" reimburse the United States for its spending on the Iran war. He said, "We’ll take all that money back, because without us they wouldn’t exist at all." According to a Pentagon estimate, the cost of the Iran war had reached $47.1 billion as of Oct. 16.

Several Middle‑East analysts say the move is more a political signal than a feasible policy. A Chatham House expert suggested Trump’s remarks are best understood as a political posture; a scholar from Kuwait University said the comments are aimed at a domestic U.S. audience, though Gulf states will interpret them similarly. Analysts also note that Trump is looking for a scapegoat after the midterms to divert attention from his defeat.

Historically, the cost‑sharing after the 1991 Gulf War was possible because it was authorized by the United Nations, whereas the 2026 Iran conflict was launched jointly by the U.S. and Israel without fully informing Gulf states in advance, making the two situations incomparable.

Gulf states find themselves in the most contradictory position. They did not initiate the war, yet they bear the brunt of Iran’s retaliatory strikes. Saudi Arabia’s third‑quarter budget deficit this year reached $22.4 billion, and attacks on Qatar’s liquefied natural gas facilities caused an estimated annual revenue loss of about $20 billion.

Allianz Trade estimates that the Gulf Cooperation Council’s GDP will contract by 4% this year, amounting to a cumulative loss of future output of roughly $790 billion. In that fiscal context, asking for an additional $4.71 billion is virtually impossible; Gulf states are expected to “quietly resist,” arguing they have already contributed through defense cooperation, base support and other accounting measures, and that alternative compensation such as investments or arms purchases merely re‑package existing obligations.

Israel is a new variable. Prime Minister Netanyahu has remained silent on the demand, while Trump announced he would halt the roughly $4 billion per‑year U.S. military aid to Israel by year‑end. Netanyahu has previously suggested cutting that aid to zero over the next decade. Trump is applying a double pressure: cutting future aid while trying to recover past costs. Yet the $4.71 billion claim has no precedent for Israel, as the United States has never asked Israel to “repay” war expenses since 1991.

Analysts conclude that Trump’s bill is unlikely to be fully enforced; Gulf states and Israel recognize it as a political gesture and are likely to respond by waiting for his attention to shift to the next target.

items.title: 黃仁勳不知黃樂是中國間諜？前CIA官員存疑：「他不可能這麼天真」
items.title_en: Did Jensen Huang Not Know Alice Huang Was a Chinese Spy? Former CIA Officer Doubts: "He Could Not Be That Naïve"
paras: 美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 週一 (9 日) 表示，輝達執行長黃仁勳宣稱完全不知道黃樂(Alice Huang) 涉嫌從事情報活動，對此，前美國中央情報局 (CIA) 中國事務分析師 Dennis Wilder 對此抱持懷疑稱：「他深諳華人文化，不可能這麼天真。」
黃仁勳絕非沒見過世面的小白兔？
《華盛頓郵報》報導，與黃仁勳交往的黃樂曾任輝達高階晶片買家 Megaspeed 的高階主管，美方情報人員懷疑她曾為北京工作。輝達董事會已宣布展開內部調查，新加坡當局也正調查 Megaspeed 是否協助將先進晶片轉運至中國。
美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 週一 (9 日) 表示，他與黃仁勳談過此事，黃仁勳告訴他，自己完全不知道對方涉嫌從事情報活動。
Wilder 對此評價：「這麼說吧，他可不是堪薩斯州托彼卡 (Topeka) 人，即絕非沒見過世面的小白兔，他深諳華人文化，不可能那麼天真。」
從私人關係接近決策圈　晶片買家身分也受關注
Wilder 指出，情報機構可以透過私人關係接近掌握敏感資訊的人。即使接觸者未受過正式情報訓練，也可能藉由這層關係接觸原本難以接近的人員或取得敏感資訊。
黃仁勳掌握輝達的商業決策，也代表公司與華府就晶片政策溝通，使這段關係受到國安界關注。
黃樂曾任職的 Megaspeed 採購輝達高階晶片。新加坡當局正在調查，這家公司是否透過東南亞將先進晶片轉運至中國。
新加坡內政部上月表示，不容許企業利用與新加坡的關聯，刻意規避或違反其他國家的出口管制。
黃樂是否參與任何轉運，以及相關交易是否與她和黃仁勳的關係有關，仍未有公開調查結論。
1980 年代曾攔下攜磁片赴北京主管　企業拒絕配合起訴
黃仁勳婚外情風波，亦讓美國科技業長期面對的反間諜問題再度受到關注。
曾參與辦案的前美國聯邦調查局 (FBI) 反間諜探員 LaRae Quy 指出，早在 1980 年代末期，FBI 就曾鎖定一名涉嫌替中國從事情報活動的矽谷科技公司主管。
該公司當時從事可用於軍事用途的機密研究，探員跟監並監聽這位高層，最後在他企圖攜帶一張磁片從舊金山飛往北京時將他逮捕。
不過，案件在逮捕後失去進展。
Quy說，該公司擔心負面報導，拒絕配合後續起訴，聯邦官員也未繼續追究。
她回憶，當時有企業寧可承受技術外流的損失，也不願面對案件曝光可能帶來的聲譽與股價衝擊。
AI 競爭升高　美方查辦商業機密竊取與晶片走私
如今，美方追查的範圍已涵蓋 AI 超級電腦架構與先進晶片的跨境流向。
美國法院今年 1 月裁定，前 Google 工程師丁林葳 (Linwei Ding) 所涉 7 項經濟間諜罪及 7 項竊取商業機密罪均成立。案件涉及逾 2,000 頁有關 Google AI 超級電腦架構的機密資料。
美國執法機關也查辦多起涉嫌將輝達先進技術轉運至中國的案件。
其中一案規模約 1.6 億美元，涉案人員被控以不實出貨文件規避出口管制。
另一起案件涉及約 25 億美元的 AI 伺服器採購，檢方指控相關受管制技術遭轉運至中國。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday (the 9th) that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang claimed he had no knowledge that Alice Huang was suspected of engaging in intelligence activities, and former CIA China analyst Dennis Wilder expressed skepticism, saying, "He is well-versed in Chinese culture and could not be that naïve."
Jensen Huang is far from being an inexperienced newcomer?

The Washington Post reported that Alice Huang, who has dealings with Jensen Huang, previously held a senior executive position at Nvidia's high‑end chip buyer Megaspeed, and U.S. intelligence officials suspect she may have worked for Beijing. Nvidia's board has announced an internal investigation, and Singapore authorities are also probing whether Megaspeed helped ship advanced chips to China.
President Trump said on Monday (the 9th) that he had discussed the matter with Jensen Huang, who told him he was completely unaware of any intelligence‑related allegations against the other party.
Wilder commented, "In other words, he's not a small‑town kid from Topeka, Kansas – certainly not an inexperienced newcomer. He knows Chinese culture inside out and could not be that naïve."
Approaching the decision‑making circle through personal ties – the chip buyer’s identity also draws attention

Wilder noted that intelligence agencies can use personal relationships to get close to people who hold sensitive information. Even if the contact lacks formal intelligence training, the relationship can provide access to otherwise hard‑to‑reach personnel or sensitive data.
Jensen Huang controls Nvidia’s business decisions and also represents the company in communications with Washington on chip policy, making this relationship a focus for national‑security officials.
Megaspeed, where Alice Huang previously worked, purchased high‑end Nvidia chips. Singapore authorities are investigating whether the firm used Southeast Asia to reroute advanced chips to China.
Singapore’s Ministry of Home Affairs said last month that companies are not allowed to use ties to Singapore to deliberately evade or violate other countries’ export controls.
Whether Alice Huang participated in any rerouting and whether related transactions are linked to her relationship with Jensen Huang remain without a public investigative conclusion.
In the 1980s, a senior official who tried to take a magnetic disk to Beijing was stopped – the company refused to cooperate with prosecution
Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair scandal has also revived attention to the long‑standing counter‑espionage issues facing the U.S. tech sector.
Former FBI counter‑espionage agent LaRae Quy, who worked on the case, said that as early as the late 1980s the FBI had targeted a senior Silicon Valley tech executive suspected of spying for China.

The company at the time was conducting classified research with potential military applications; agents surveilled and tapped the executive, and ultimately arrested him when he attempted to fly a magnetic disk from San Francisco to Beijing.
However, the case stalled after the arrest.
Quy said the company feared negative publicity, refused to cooperate with further prosecution, and federal officials did not pursue the matter further.
She recalled that companies sometimes prefer to endure the loss of technology leakage rather than face the reputational and stock‑price damage that could arise from a public case.
AI competition is intensifying, and U.S. authorities are investigating commercial espionage and chip smuggling.
Today, U.S. investigations cover cross‑border flows of AI supercomputer architectures and advanced chips.

In January this year, a U.S. court found former Google engineer Linwei Ding guilty on seven counts of economic espionage and seven counts of trade‑secret theft, involving over 2,000 pages of confidential material on Google’s AI supercomputer architecture.
U.S. law‑enforcement agencies are also probing multiple cases alleged to involve the transfer of Nvidia’s advanced technology to China.
One case involves roughly $160 million, with defendants charged with using false shipping documents to evade export controls.
Another case concerns about $2.5 billion in AI server purchases, with prosecutors alleging that controlled technology was rerouted to China.

items.title: 輝達客戶Megaspeed為何未列黑名單？貝森特白宮質問盧特尼克
items.title_en: Why Is Nvidia Customer Megaspeed Not Blacklisted? Bessent Questions Lutnick at the White House
paras: 《Axios》報導，美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 上週在白宮戰情室當面追問商務部長盧特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)，為何涉嫌將輝達 (NVDA-US) 先進人工智慧 (AI) 晶片轉運至中國的經銷商 Megaspeed，至今仍未被列入美國商務部的實體清單。
這場交鋒凸顯，川普政府內部對於是否應限制這家輝達大客戶取得美國技術，以及此舉可能對美中貿易關係造成的影響，存在分歧。
據知悉會議內容的人士透露，貝森特在會中問道：「為什麼 Megaspeed 還沒被列入實體清單？」
盧特尼克一時語塞，隨後表示：「我不知道，我會查一下。」
企業一旦被列入實體清單，供應商向其出口、再出口或移轉受管制產品，通常須先取得美國商務部許可，實際限制取決於個別列名條件。
白宮與情報官員自去年秋季促請商務部介入
知情人士報導，白宮與美國情報機構官員自 2025 年秋季起便敦促商務部採取行動。兼任國家安全顧問的國務卿盧比歐 (Marco Rubio) 也曾向盧特尼克提交備忘錄，詳列 Megaspeed 涉及的國安疑慮。
知情人士稱，盧特尼克過去一年多次擋下或撤回其他官員推動的措施，因為擔心對 Megaspeed 出手會使美中貿易關係進一步緊張。
《紐約時報》另報導，輝達介入後，商務部主管出口管制的次長凱斯勒 (Jeffrey Kessler) 曾突然叫停一項針對 Megaspeed 的調查。
貝森特此次追問的是商務部是否對 Megaspeed 採取出口限制，而這項報導則將焦點拉回商務部先前如何處理相關調查。
逾 48 億美元晶片採購受查 輝達董事會調查黃仁勳
據報，Megaspeed 曾採購逾 48 億美元的輝達先進晶片。美方調查焦點在於其中是否有晶片遭轉運至中國、最終流向哪些企業，以及相關交易有無違反美國出口管制。
48 億美元是據報採購總額，實際流入中國的金額仍待釐清。
Megaspeed 前高層黃樂 (Alice Huang) 被指透過與輝達執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 及輝達經銷商的關係，協助中國企業取得晶片。
美國情報官員懷疑黃樂涉及中國情報活動。
輝達上週日披露，黃仁勳向董事會告知兩人的親密關係後，董事會將展開調查。黃仁勳否認知悉任何間諜行動。
《紐約時報》報導，美國官員曾在 5 月向川普簡報黃樂與中國政府的疑似關聯。
川普近日被問及此事時，仍公開肯定黃仁勳，稱他是個正派的人，可能有理由解釋，並表示他為美國做了很出色的工作。
觀察出口許可 黃仁勳在華府的影響力恐受削弱
科技研究機構 Moor Insights & Strategy 執行長 Patrick Moorhead 先前指出，這場風波已削弱黃仁勳在華府推動出口政策的影響力，美國政府日後審查輝達對中出口許可時，可能將此事納入考量。
對輝達而言，近期要觀察的是商務部會否將 Megaspeed 列入實體清單。
若限制進一步擴及其他經銷商或海外轉售管道，輝達面臨的影響就會從單一客戶交易，延伸到更多通路的最終買家查核與出口許可審查。
paras_en: Axios reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent last week confronted Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick face‑to‑face in the White House war room, asking why the Nvidia (NVDA-US) advanced AI chip distributor Megaspeed, which is suspected of shipping chips to China, has not yet been placed on the Commerce Department’s Entity List.

The showdown highlighted internal divisions within the Trump administration over whether this major Nvidia customer should be barred from accessing U.S. technology and the potential impact such a move could have on U.S.–China trade relations.
People familiar with the meeting said Bessent asked, “Why hasn’t Megaspeed been added to the Entity List yet?”
Lutnick was momentarily at a loss for words and later replied, “I don’t know, I’ll look into it.”

When a company is placed on the Entity List, suppliers must generally obtain a Commerce Department license before exporting, re‑exporting, or transferring controlled items to it, and the actual restrictions depend on the specific listing criteria.
The White House and intelligence officials have been urging the Commerce Department to act since last fall.

Sources reported that the White House and U.S. intelligence officials have been pressing the Commerce Department since the autumn of 2025. National Security Advisor and Secretary of State Marco Rubio also submitted a memorandum to Lutnick outlining national‑security concerns involving Megaspeed.

Sources said Lutnick has repeatedly blocked or withdrawn measures proposed by other officials over the past year, fearing that taking action against Megaspeed would further strain U.S.–China trade ties.
The New York Times also reported that after Nvidia became involved, Commerce Department deputy assistant secretary for export controls Jeffrey Kessler abruptly halted an investigation into Megaspeed.

Bessent’s line of questioning focused on whether the Commerce Department has imposed export restrictions on Megaspeed, while the report shifts attention back to how the department previously handled related investigations.
More than $4.8 billion in chip purchases under investigation – Nvidia board probes Jensen Huang.

According to reports, Megaspeed purchased over $4.8 billion worth of Nvidia’s advanced chips. U.S. investigators are looking into whether any of those chips were shipped to China, which companies ultimately received them, and whether the transactions violated U.S. export controls.
The $4.8 billion figure reflects the reported total purchase amount; the actual value that may have ended up in China remains to be clarified.
Former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang is accused of leveraging her relationships with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Nvidia’s distributors to help Chinese firms obtain the chips.
U.S. intelligence officials suspect that Alice Huang is involved in Chinese intelligence activities.

Nvidia disclosed last Sunday that after Jensen Huang informed the board of his close relationship with Huang, the board will launch an investigation. Huang denied any knowledge of espionage activities.
The New York Times reported that U.S. officials briefed Trump in May about the alleged link between Alice Huang and the Chinese government.

When Trump was recently asked about the matter, he publicly defended Jensen Huang, calling him an upstanding person who may have a reason to explain himself and saying Huang has done an excellent job for the United States.
Observing export licenses, Jensen Huang’s influence in Washington may be weakened.

Patrick Moorhead, CEO of research firm Moor Insights & Strategy, previously noted that the controversy has eroded Huang’s sway over export‑policy lobbying in Washington, and that the U.S. government may factor the issue into future reviews of Nvidia’s export licenses to China.
For Nvidia, the immediate focus is whether the Commerce Department will add Megaspeed to the Entity List.

If restrictions expand to other distributors or overseas resale channels, Nvidia’s exposure could grow from a single‑customer deal to broader scrutiny of downstream buyers and additional export‑license reviews.

items.title: 馬斯克屢陷風波仍獲股東力挺 黃仁勳也能過關嗎？
items.title_en: Musk Weathered Multiple Controversies Yet Retains Shareholder Support – Can Jensen Huang Also Get Through It?
paras: 黃仁勳婚外情風波讓輝達(NVDA-US)投資人面對一項特斯拉(TSLA-US)股東早已熟悉的考驗：當公司命運與創辦人緊密相連，個人爭議會帶來多大衝擊？馬斯克歷經多次風波仍獲股東支持，但黃仁勳能否同樣過關，仍存在不確定性。
黃仁勳與一名被指涉及中國間諜活動女子的婚外情，引發利益衝突與國家安全疑慮，相關問題仍待調查釐清。輝達股價此前兩個交易日累計下跌約10%，較10月的52周高點回落約31%，凸顯高度依賴單一領導者的「關鍵人物風險」。

創辦人撐起公司成長 接班缺口也成隱憂

Futurum執行長Daniel Newman指出，黃仁勳是非常獨特的執行長，輝達組織比傳統企業更加扁平，幾乎圍繞他的個人願景運作。目前外界不知道有任何明確接班計畫，公司內部也沒有一位公認能在他離職後接棒的領導者。
這種高度依賴創辦人的模式，與馬斯克之於特斯拉相似。聖塔克拉拉大學副教授Jo-Ellen Pozner認為，兩家公司都有強勢創辦人兼執行長，並對董事會發揮重大影響力。
創辦人掌舵確實可能創造可觀財富。哥倫比亞商學院教授Shivaram Rajgopal指出，特斯拉與Meta(META-US)等企業的創辦人，能帶來專業經理人未必具備的活力。
但他強調，董事會仍須履行規劃未來的責任。黃仁勳風波反映部分大型科技公司的脆弱之處：即使已是上市巨頭，運作方式仍可能像私人企業，董事會也受到家族式關係影響。

股東願為報酬承受多少風險 黃仁勳面臨信任考驗

強勢領導者帶來的風險，往往反映在股價波動。報導指出，特斯拉波動程度約為一般股票的兩倍，輝達近期也出現類似情況。
若報酬夠高，投資人可能願意承受震盪。截至周三交易前，輝達過去五年上漲455%，領先標普500近400個百分點；特斯拉同期卻僅上漲約10%，顯示創辦人的光環並不保證持續帶來優異績效。
馬斯克歷經美國證管會罰款與調查、誹謗訴訟，並將心力投入其他企業與政治活動，仍獲投資人支持。特斯拉股東2025年更批准一項潛在價值可達1兆美元的薪酬方案。
黃仁勳也可能挺過風波，但投資人仍須思考：輝達股價包含多少對他個人的信任？若他必須離開，公司由誰接手？這些問題將影響市場如何評估輝達的價值與風險。
paras_en: Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair scandal forces Nvidia (NVDA-US) investors to face a test familiar to Tesla (TSLA-US) shareholders: when a company’s fate is tightly linked to its founder, how much impact can personal controversies have? Musk has survived numerous storms with shareholder backing, but it remains uncertain whether Huang can do the same.

Huang’s alleged affair with a woman accused of involvement in Chinese espionage has raised conflict‑of‑interest and national‑security concerns, issues that are still under investigation. Nvidia’s share price fell about 10% over the previous two trading days, retreating roughly 31% from its 52‑week high in October, highlighting the “key‑person risk” of heavy reliance on a single leader.

Founder‑driven growth and a succession gap are also worries. Futurum CEO Daniel Newman notes that Huang is a uniquely influential CEO and that Nvidia’s organization is flatter than a traditional firm, operating almost entirely around his personal vision. No clear succession plan is known publicly, and there is no recognized internal leader ready to take over if he departs.

This founder‑centric model mirrors Musk’s role at Tesla. Santa Clara University associate professor Jo‑Ellen Pozner says both companies have strong founder‑CEOs who wield significant influence over their boards.

A founder at the helm can indeed generate substantial wealth. Columbia Business School professor Shivaram Rajgopal points out that founders of firms like Tesla and Meta (META‑US) bring a dynamism that professional managers may lack.

However, he stresses that boards must still fulfill their duty to plan for the future. Huang’s scandal exposes a fragility in some large tech firms: even as public giants, they can operate like private companies, with boards swayed by family‑style relationships.

How much risk shareholders are willing to bear for compensation is now under scrutiny, and Huang faces a trust test. The risk associated with strong leaders often shows up in stock volatility. Reports note Tesla’s volatility is about twice that of a typical stock, and Nvidia has shown similar behavior recently.

If compensation is high enough, investors may tolerate the swings. As of Wednesday’s trading, Nvidia has risen 455% over the past five years, outpacing the S&P 500 by nearly 400 percentage points; Tesla, by contrast, has risen only about 10% in the same period, showing that a founder’s halo does not guarantee sustained superior performance.

Musk has endured SEC fines and investigations, defamation lawsuits, and has poured energy into other ventures and political activities, yet still enjoys investor support. Tesla shareholders even approved a potential compensation package in 2025 that could be worth up to $1 trillion.

Huang may also survive the scandal, but investors must consider how much of Nvidia’s price reflects trust in him personally. If he has to leave, who will take over? These questions will shape how the market values Nvidia’s risk and upside.

items.title: 蘋果AI眼鏡添新線索！供應商透露參與專案 新款智慧耳機也在列
items.title_en: Apple AI Glasses Get New Clues! Supplier Reveals Participation in Project, New Smart Earbuds Also in the Works
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)布局AI穿戴裝置傳出新線索。中國製造設備供應商快克智能(603203-SH)在第三季業績說明會透露，已參與蘋果AI眼鏡及新款智慧耳機專案，預期有助帶動精密焊接組裝與機器視覺檢測等業務，但未揭露產品規格、訂單金額或上市時間。
據《財聯社》及《MacRumors》等報導，快克智能11月10日表示，受惠半導體、光通訊與資料中心產業需求成長，公司第三季合約負債較去年同期及前一季增加，在手訂單充足，並提及參與蘋果尚未發表的穿戴裝置專案。
這項說法為蘋果智慧眼鏡與新型耳機的開發傳聞增添供應鏈線索。不過，公司僅稱「新款智慧耳機」，沒有直接提及AirPods或攝影鏡頭，因此尚不能據此確認，相關專案就是外界傳聞的鏡頭版AirPods。
根據先前報導，蘋果首款智慧眼鏡可能於2027年底推出，初代預期不具備擴增實境(AR)顯示功能，而是透過鏡頭、麥克風及揚聲器，結合Siri與Apple Intelligence，協助使用者理解周遭環境、回答問題及翻譯語言。上述功能與時程仍屬產品傳聞，並非此次供應商揭露的內容。
至於配備鏡頭的AirPods，外媒先前報導，其概念是利用耳機上的低解析度鏡頭取得環境資訊，再交由附近iPhone的Apple Intelligence處理，讓AI助理能依使用者眼前的情境提供協助。
MacRumors指出，這款耳機傳出可能與iPhone問世20周年機種同期登場。不過，供應商參與專案並不代表產品已確定量產，蘋果也尚未正式公布上述產品，最終設計與推出時程仍待確認。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is reportedly advancing its AI wearables, with new clues emerging. Chinese equipment maker Kuake Smart (603203-SH) disclosed at its Q3 earnings briefing that it has taken part in Apple’s AI glasses and new smart earbud projects, which it expects will boost its precision welding assembly and machine‑vision inspection businesses. The company did not reveal product specifications, order values, or launch timelines.

According to reports from Caixin and MacRumors, Kuake Smart said on November 10 that it is benefiting from growing demand in the semiconductor, optical‑communication and data‑center sectors. The firm’s Q3 contract backlog rose compared with both the same period last year and the previous quarter, leaving it with ample orders, and it mentioned involvement in an as‑yet‑unannounced Apple wearables project.

This comment adds a supply‑chain hint to the rumors surrounding Apple’s smart glasses and a new type of earbud. However, the company only referred to a “new smart earbud” and did not specifically name AirPods or a camera‑equipped version, so the claim cannot confirm that the project is the camera‑enabled AirPods that have been circulating in the media.

Earlier reports suggested that Apple’s first smart glasses could debut by the end of 2027. The initial model is expected to lack augmented‑reality displays and instead rely on a camera, microphone and speaker, combined with Siri and Apple Intelligence, to help users understand their surroundings, answer questions and translate languages. Those features and timelines remain speculative and were not disclosed by the supplier.

Regarding camera‑equipped AirPods, foreign media have previously reported a concept where low‑resolution cameras on the earbuds capture environmental data, which is then processed by a nearby iPhone’s Apple Intelligence, allowing the AI assistant to provide context‑aware help based on what the user sees.

MacRumors notes that the earbuds could launch alongside the iPhone model commemorating the device’s 20th anniversary. Nonetheless, a supplier’s involvement does not guarantee mass production, Apple has not officially announced the products, and the final design and release schedule remain unconfirmed.

items.title: 目標價500砍到200美元！輝達遭罕見降評 大摩也撤首選
items.title_en: Target Price Slashed from $500 to $200: Nvidia Faces Rare Downgrade, Morgan Stanley Removes It From Preferred List
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳風波持續延燒，華爾街罕見出現降評。Baird周三(11日)將輝達評等降至「中立」，目標價從500美元大砍至200美元；摩根士丹利(MS-US)也將其移出首選股名單，但維持「加碼」評等。
綜合外媒報導，黃仁勳與一名被指涉及中國間諜活動女子的婚外情，已引發董事會內部調查、聯邦調查局(FBI)調查及政界要求辭職的聲浪。相關疑慮尚待釐清，市場則開始評估事件對輝達領導穩定性、出口管制及營收的影響。

Baird降評背後 出口限制恐衝擊庫存與營收

Baird分析師Tristan Gerra表示，在政府調查、國會簡報後可能採取的措施、潛在財務影響，以及黃仁勳去留等問題明朗前，將採取更謹慎立場。
Gerra警告，美國可能重新禁止H200晶片銷往中國，迫使輝達調降相關庫存價值，估計可能造成約50億美元存貨跌價損失。不過，這是分析師的情境推估，並非已宣布的禁令或公司確認的損失。
另一項風險是美國進一步收緊出口管制，堵住中國客戶經由東南亞資料中心取得晶片的漏洞。Gerra認為，相關措施可能促使區域內涉及中國需求的業者調整營運，而中國相關GPU需求歷來可能高於華爾街估計。
目前，美國雲端業者對輝達晶片的需求仍遠超供給。Gerra認為，東南亞需求轉弱的影響，原則上可由其他需求吸收至明年；但若中國相關訂單突然消失，恰逢大型雲端客戶當季支出受限，就未必能立即補上缺口，衝擊可能集中在特定季度。
此外，2027年資料中心支出的能見度仍有限，零組件供應受限與潛在需求降溫，都可能拖慢建設。Gerra估計，大型雲端業者AI支出的年增率可能降至40%或以下，輝達股價在不確定性消退前，可能維持區間震盪。

大摩觸發停損政策 華爾街整體仍偏多

大摩撤除首選資格，則涉及該行停損政策。分析師Joseph Moore指出，輝達自10月2日被列入首選股以來，股價已下跌逾25%。
Moore仍維持「加碼」評等，但強調黃仁勳的領導對公司策略方向至關重要，因此短期不確定性仍將持續。移出首選名單，並不代表大摩已全面轉為看空輝達。
其他券商也調整推薦，美國銀行(BAC-US)將輝達移出US 1首選股名單，富國銀行(WFC-US)、花旗(C-US)等則下修目標價。
不過，華爾街整體仍偏多。LSEG數據顯示，64家券商中仍有59家給予「買進」或「強力買進」，目標價中位數為314美元。輝達將於11月17日公布第三季財報，營運展望及管理層對相關風險的說明，將成為市場下一個關注焦點。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang’s controversy continues to flare, prompting a rare downgrade on Wall Street. Baird on Wednesday (the 11th) cut Nvidia’s rating to "Neutral" and slashed the target price from $500 to $200; Morgan Stanley (MS-US) also removed the stock from its preferred‑share list, though it kept a "Buy‑more" rating.

According to foreign media reports, Huang’s alleged extramarital affair with a woman accused of involvement in Chinese espionage has triggered an internal board investigation, an FBI probe and political calls for his resignation. With the concerns still unresolved, the market is beginning to assess the impact of the episode on Nvidia’s leadership stability, export controls and revenue.

Baird’s downgrade stems from fears that export restrictions could hit inventory and earnings. Baird analyst Tristan Gerra said that until the outcomes of the government investigation, congressional briefings, potential measures, financial impact and Huang’s future are clearer, a more cautious stance is warranted.

Gerra warned that the United States could re‑impose a ban on H200 chips to China, forcing Nvidia to write down the value of related inventory, which could result in roughly $5 billion of inventory impairment. He stressed this is a scenario‑based estimate, not an announced ban or a confirmed loss by the company.

Another risk is further tightening of U.S. export controls that would close the loophole allowing Chinese customers to obtain chips via Southeast Asian data centers. Gerra believes such measures could cause operators in the region with Chinese demand to adjust operations, and that Chinese GPU demand has historically been higher than Wall Street estimates.

Currently, U.S. cloud providers’ demand for Nvidia chips far exceeds supply. Gerra thinks the impact of weaker Southeast Asian demand can generally be absorbed by other demand into next year; however, if Chinese‑related orders disappear suddenly while large cloud customers face spending constraints in the quarter, the gap may not be filled immediately, concentrating the hit in specific quarters.

Moreover, visibility for data‑center spending in 2027 remains limited, and component supply constraints plus potential demand cooling could slow construction. Gerra estimates large cloud providers’ AI‑spending annual growth could fall to 40% or lower, and Nvidia’s share price may stay in a range until the uncertainties recede.

Morgan Stanley’s removal of Nvidia from its preferred list is tied to the firm’s stop‑loss policy. Analyst Joseph Moore noted that since Nvidia was added to the preferred list on October 2, the stock has fallen more than 25%.

Moore still maintains a "Buy‑more" rating but stresses that Huang’s leadership is critical to the company’s strategic direction, so short‑term uncertainty will persist. Being taken off the preferred list does not mean Morgan Stanley has turned fully bearish on Nvidia.

Other brokerages have also adjusted recommendations: Bank of America (BAC-US) removed Nvidia from its US 1 preferred list, while Wells Fargo (WFC-US), Citigroup (C-US) and others cut their target prices.

Nevertheless, Wall Street remains overall bullish. LSEG data show that out of 64 brokerages, 59 still rate Nvidia as "Buy" or "Strong Buy," with a median target price of $314. Nvidia will report its Q3 results on November 17, and the outlook and management’s commentary on the related risks will be the next market focus.

items.title: 美晶片出口管制沒用！中國大學持續取得輝達高階AI晶片
items.title_en: US Chip Export Controls Ineffective! Chinese Universities Continue to Acquire Nvidia's High-End AI Chips
paras: 《路透》報導，與中國解放軍關係密切的西北工業大學，雖已被美國列入出口管制實體清單，仍在 10 月透過中國供應商購入兩顆輝達 (NVDA-US) H200 人工智慧 (AI) 晶片，總價人民幣 87 萬 4,700 元，約 12.3 萬美元，該校今年另簽下五份算力租賃合約，取得搭載 H200 等受管制晶片的伺服器使用權，凸顯華府除了審查出口對象，也面臨晶片轉售及算力服務的監管難題。
《路透》查閱西北工業大學 10 月 21 日公布的採購紀錄發現，這兩顆 H200 由該校管理學院向陝西博算網路科技採購，交易對手為中國本地供應商。
西北工業大學位於西安，是中國「國防七子」之一，研究涵蓋軍用飛機、飛彈與衛星。美國商務部 2001 年將該校列入實體清單，2019 年進一步收緊限制，多數受管制技術的出口許可申請原則上不予核准。
該校網路安全學院今年 1 月另簽下兩份為期七個月的算力合約，每份均可使用搭載八顆 H200 的伺服器，金額分別為人民幣 44 萬 1,700 元及 44 萬 1,000 元，用於 AI 模型微調及強化學習訓練。
該校另一個研究單位 4 月也以人民幣 37 萬 5,000 元採購運算服務，要求至少使用 24 顆輝達 A100 晶片，供結構與流體力學模擬使用。
公開紀錄列出採購方、本地供應商與部分合約用途，但晶片最初如何進入中國、出租伺服器設在何處，仍有待釐清。
多所中國高校取得受管制晶片
類似交易也出現在其他高校。
深圳大學 9 月以人民幣 76 萬 9,800 元購入三顆 H100。武漢理工大學 6 月以人民幣 35 萬 5,000 元採購一台搭載 H100 的伺服器，另以人民幣 34 萬 4,000 元購入四顆 A100。
同屬「國防七子」的北京航空航天大學則在 4 月以人民幣 48 萬 9,000 元採購四顆 A800。
川普政府今年 1 月起，對符合條件的 H200 對中出口申請改採個案審查，實體清單上的機構仍受原有的終端使用者限制。
新規也要求收貨方查核客戶身分，防止未獲授權的對象遠端使用晶片。
美國國會兩黨議員正推動晶片追蹤措施及加強國會對出口許可的監督。
輝達執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 則主張，持續向中國銷售晶片，有助維持美國的技術領先地位，並讓中國客戶繼續使用美國技術。
輝達先前在財報中揭露，儘管美方自 2 月起核准向特定中國客戶少量出口 H200，北京的限制使實際出貨僅達美方核准數量的一小部分。輝達已在 2027 會計年度上半年認列 4 億美元的 H200 相關費用，涉及過剩庫存與採購承諾。依輝達當時的申報，許可計畫下的 H200 出貨占該季資料中心營收不到 1%。
Baird 分析師 Tristan Gerra 將輝達評等下調至「中立」，理由包括美國政府調查、營收風險及黃仁勳能否續任的不確定性。
Gerra 指出，若華府重新禁止 H200 對中出口，輝達可能面臨約 50 億美元的資產減記。他也預期，美方可能收緊對東南亞資料中心的出口管制，以減少受管制晶片經第三地流入中國的風險。
受黃仁勳婚外情風波牽連，AI巨頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 已連續重挫兩個交易日，週三 (11日) 逢低買盤回流，股價收紅2.92% 至每股173.73 美元，今年以來累計下滑 8%。
paras_en: Reuters reported that Northwestern Polytechnical University, which has close ties to the Chinese People’s Liberation Army and is already on the U.S. export‑control entity list, bought two Nvidia (NVDA-US) H200 artificial‑intelligence chips in October through a Chinese supplier for a total of RMB 874,700 (about $123,000). The university also signed five compute‑capacity leasing contracts this year to obtain server access that includes H200 and other restricted chips, highlighting that Washington faces not only export‑to‑entity scrutiny but also challenges regulating chip resale and compute‑as‑a‑service.

The Reuters review of Northwestern Polytechnical University’s procurement record dated 21 October shows that the two H200 chips were purchased by the university’s School of Management from Shaanxi BoSuan Network Technology, a domestic Chinese supplier.

Northwestern Polytechnical University, located in Xi’an, is one of China’s “Seven Defense Universities” and conducts research on military aircraft, missiles and satellites. The U.S. Department of Commerce added the school to the Entity List in 2001 and tightened restrictions in 2019, generally denying export licences for most controlled technologies.

In January this year, the university’s School of Cybersecurity signed two seven‑month compute contracts, each granting access to a server equipped with eight H200 chips, for RMB 441,700 and RMB 441,000 respectively, to be used for AI model fine‑tuning and reinforcement‑learning training.
Another research unit at the university purchased computing services in April for RMB 375,000, requiring the use of at least 24 Nvidia A100 chips for structural and fluid‑mechanics simulations.

Public records list the purchaser, the domestic supplier and parts of the contract purpose, but it remains unclear how the chips originally entered China and where the leased servers are physically located.
Several Chinese universities have obtained restricted chips.
Similar transactions have appeared at other universities.

Shenzhen University bought three H100 chips in September for RMB 769,800. Wuhan University of Technology purchased a server with an H100 in June for RMB 355,000 and bought four A100 chips for RMB 344,000.
Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, also a “Seven Defense University,” bought four A800 chips in April for RMB 489,000.
Since January, the Trump administration has shifted to case‑by‑case review for eligible H200 exports to China, while entities on the Entity List remain subject to the original end‑user restrictions.
The new rules also require the recipient to verify the customer’s identity to prevent unauthorized remote use of the chips.
Bipartisan members of Congress are pushing chip‑tracking measures and stronger congressional oversight of export licences.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argues that continuing to sell chips to China helps maintain U.S. technological leadership and allows Chinese customers to keep using U.S. technology.

Nvidia disclosed in its earnings that, although the U.S. approved limited H200 shipments to certain Chinese customers starting in February, Beijing’s restrictions meant actual shipments were only a small fraction of the approved amount. Nvidia recorded $400 million of H200‑related expenses in the first half of fiscal 2027, tied to excess inventory and purchase commitments. Under the licence programme, H200 shipments accounted for less than 1% of the quarter’s data‑center revenue.
Baird analyst Tristan Gerra downgraded Nvidia to a “Neutral” rating, citing U.S. government investigations, revenue risk and uncertainty over Jensen Huang’s tenure.

Gerra noted that if Washington re‑bans H200 exports to China, Nvidia could face roughly $5 billion of asset write‑downs. He also expects the U.S. may tighten export controls on Southeast Asian data centres to reduce the risk of restricted chips flowing to China via third‑party locations.

Affected by Jensen Huang’s extramarital‑affair scandal, AI giant Nvidia (NVDA-US) has fallen for two consecutive trading days; on Wednesday (the 11th) buying pressure returned, lifting the stock 2.92% to $173.73 per share, down 8% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉CoreWeave點燃AI買盤 輝達終止連二跌 費半勁揚超5.6%
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: CoreWeave Ignites AI Buying, Nvidia Stops Two-Day Decline, Philly Semiconductor Index Jumps Over 5.6%
paras: 美股週三 (11 日) 四大指數收高，AI 雲端業者 CoreWeave 第三季營收優於預期，並上調全年財測，股價飆漲近 25%，帶動 AI 概念股反彈。輝達結束連兩日跌勢，那斯達克指數上漲 1.60%，費城半導體指數勁揚 5.66%。
CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 上調 2026 年營收與營業利益展望，緩解市場對 AI 基礎設施需求的疑慮。
AI 新創 Anthropic 也在更新的申報文件中表示，計畫於下週首次公開募股 (IPO)，擬發行 8.25 億股，估值最高可達 1.4 兆美元。這筆 IPO 已獲超額認購，OpenAI 單季營收則達 100 億美元。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 週三止跌回升，執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 坦承婚外情後，輝達本週前兩個交易日累跌近 10%。兩名共和黨籍眾議員週三表示，國會已準備傳喚黃仁勳，就這段關係提供說明。
通膨數據仍牽動利率預期。美國 10 月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 月增 0.4%，高於市場預期。
芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比 (Austan Goolsbee) 形容，這份通膨報告再度令人憂心。聯準會 (Fed) 理事華勒 (Christopher Waller) 週二的談話，也推升市場對 12 月升息的預期。
芝商所 (CME) FedWatch 工具顯示，數據公布後，市場估計 12 月升息一碼的機率升至約九成。
美債現貨市場週三因退伍軍人節休市，美債期貨小幅走低，美元觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最高水準。
美股週三 (11 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 下跌 1.97%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 2.04%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 2.11%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.26%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 1.74%。
半導體指標股齊揚。AMD (AMD-US) 飆漲 7.32%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 3.99%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 2.87%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 飆漲 6.05%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.75%。
記憶體與儲存族群全面走高。美光 (MU-US) 狂升 11.89%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 暴漲 8.34%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 瘋漲 13.69%；希捷 (STX-US) 飆漲 9.99%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 狂飆 9.71%。
台股 ADR 全數收紅。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 大漲 4.25%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 猛升 6.60%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 大漲 6.91%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 微漲 0.45%。
企業新聞
CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 飆漲超 24% 至每股 60.77 美元，創2025年6月以來最強單日表現。 這家 AI 雲端業者公布亮眼的第三季財報，緩解市場對其資產負債表的疑慮。執行長英特雷特 (Michael Intrator) 表示，公司將停止在公開市場發行無擔保債券，改採過去曾使用、可在約定期限內按需提款的貸款額度。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 週三上漲 2.87%，收報 173.73 美元。投資機構 Baird 同日將輝達評等由「優於大盤」下調至「中立」，並呼籲黃仁勳辭任執行長。黃仁勳坦承與一名被指涉嫌替中國從事間諜活動的女子有婚外情後，華爾街對他的去留日益感到不安。
Nebius (NBIS-US) 飛漲逾 15% 至每股 154.69 美元。同為 AI 雲端業者的 Nebius 受到 CoreWeave 財報激勵，將於週四美股開盤前公布第三季財報。
好市多 (COST-US) 走升約 2% 至每股 1,087.61 美元。 這家倉儲式零售商宣布發放每股 30 美元的特別股息，為上一次特別股息的兩倍。董事會也重新授權 40 億美元的庫藏股計畫。
華爾街分析
貝爾德私人財富管理投資策略師 Ross Mayfield 表示，CoreWeave 財報與 Anthropic IPO 的認購需求改善了整個 AI 產業鏈的投資氣氛。上週賣壓消化後，市場正收復部分失地，許多 AI 股的短期估值與獲利前景也重新吸引買盤。
貝萊德全球固定收益投資長 Rick Rieder 研判，通膨仍高於 Fed 希望看到的水準，12 月升息是貝萊德與市場的基本預期，接下來的焦點是升息幅度。
摩根大通資產管理全球策略師 David Kelly 則認為，即使最新 CPI 高於預期，Fed 也沒有必要在 12 月升息兩碼。
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: U.S. stocks on Wednesday (the 11th) saw all four major indexes close higher. AI cloud provider CoreWeave posted third‑quarter revenue that beat expectations and raised its full‑year outlook, sending its shares up nearly 25% and sparking a rebound in AI‑related stocks. Nvidia ended a two‑day losing streak, the Nasdaq rose 1.60%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged 5.66%.
CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) lifted its 2026 revenue and operating‑income forecasts, easing market concerns about demand for AI infrastructure.

AI startup Anthropic disclosed in a filing that it plans an initial public offering next week, aiming to sell 825 million shares and valuing the company at up to $1.4 trillion. The IPO has already been oversubscribed, and OpenAI reported quarterly revenue of $10 billion.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) halted its decline on Wednesday and moved higher. CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, after which Nvidia had fallen nearly 10% over the prior two trading sessions. Two Republican members of Congress said on Wednesday that the House is prepared to summon Huang for an explanation of the relationship.
Inflation data continues to drive interest‑rate expectations. U.S. consumer price index (CPI) for October rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, above market forecasts.

Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee described the inflation report as again worrisome. Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks on Tuesday also lifted market expectations for a rate hike in December.
The CME FedWatch tool showed that after the data release, the market’s probability of a one‑point rate increase in December rose to roughly 90%.
U.S. Treasury spot markets were closed on Wednesday for Veterans Day, and Treasury futures slipped slightly while the dollar reached its highest level since May 2025.
U.S. stock market performance on Wednesday (the 11th):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 254.60 points, or 0.49%, to 52,486.49.
The Nasdaq Composite gained 400.31 points, or 1.60%, to 25,466.19.
The S&P 500 added 98.45 points, or 1.31%, to 7,619.38.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 565.78 points, or 5.66%, to 10,564.11.
The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 310.80 points, or 1.80%, to 17,585.25.

Focus stocks:
Among the five big‑tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index, gains and losses were mixed. Meta (META‑US) fell 1.97%; Apple (AAPL‑US) rose 2.04%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) climbed 2.11%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) dropped 2.26%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) slipped 1.74%.

Semiconductor bellwethers all rallied. AMD (AMD‑US) surged 7.32%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) rose 3.99%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) climbed 2.87%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) jumped 6.05%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) gained 1.75%.

Memory and storage stocks moved higher across the board. Micron (MU‑US) surged 11.89%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) leapt 8.34%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) rocketed 13.69%; Seagate (STX‑US) rose 9.99%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) spiked 9.71%.
All Taiwan‑related ADRs closed in the green. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) jumped 4.25%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) surged 6.60%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) rose 6.91%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) edged up 0.45%.
Company news:

CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) rocketed more than 24% to $60.77 per share, marking its strongest single‑day gain since June 2025. The AI cloud provider posted an impressive third‑quarter report that eased balance‑sheet concerns. CEO Michael Intrater said the company will stop issuing unsecured bonds in the public market and will instead rely on a loan facility previously used that allows drawdowns on demand within a set term.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) rose 2.87% on Wednesday, closing at $173.73. Investment firm Baird downgraded Nvidia that day from "outperform" to "neutral" and called for Jensen Huang to step down as CEO. After Huang admitted an affair with a woman alleged to have spied for China, Wall Street’s confidence in his leadership has waned.

Nebius (NBIS‑US) surged over 15% to $154.69 per share. The AI cloud competitor Nebius, buoyed by CoreWeave’s earnings, will release its own third‑quarter results before the U.S. market opens on Thursday.

Costco (COST‑US) climbed about 2% to $1,087.61 per share. The warehouse retailer announced a special dividend of $30 per share, double the previous special dividend, and the board re‑authorized a $4 billion share‑repurchase program.
Wall Street analysis:

Ross Mayfield, investment strategist at Baird Private Wealth Management, said CoreWeave’s earnings and the demand for Anthropic’s IPO have improved sentiment across the AI supply chain. After last week’s selling pressure was absorbed, the market is recapturing ground, and many AI stocks’ short‑term valuations and earnings outlooks are once again attracting buyers.

Rick Rieder, global fixed‑income chief investment officer at BlackRock, judged that inflation remains above the level the Fed wants to see, making a December rate hike the baseline expectation for BlackRock and the market, with the focus now on the size of the hike.
David Kelly, global strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, argued that even though the latest CPI came in hotter than expected, the Fed does not need to raise rates by two points in December.

items.title: 471億美元！川普點名以色列等六國為伊朗戰事買單　分析人士：政治姿態難兌現
items.title_en: $47.1 Billion! Trump Names Israel and Six Other Nations to Pay for the Iran War – Analysts Say the Political Gesture Is Hard to Fulfill
paras: 美國期中選舉慘敗後第三天，總統川普在電視節目中首次點名以色列、沙烏地阿拉伯、阿聯、卡達、巴林和科威特，要求它們「100%」償還美國在伊朗戰事中的開支。他說：「我們會把那些錢全部拿回來，因為如果沒有我們，它們根本不會存在。」根據五角大廈估算，截至10月16日，伊朗戰事成本達471億美元。
多位中東問題分析人士判斷，這更接近政治信號，而非可執行的政策。查塔姆研究所專家表示，川普的話最好被理解為政治姿態；科威特大學學者則稱這番話面向美國國內民眾，波斯灣國家也會這樣理解。分析師還說，川普在期中選舉後正尋找替罪羊，轉移對敗選的注意力。
歷史上，1991年波斯灣戰爭後的成本分攤因有聯合國授權而實現，而2026年伊朗戰事由美以聯合發動，波斯灣國家事先未被充分告知，兩者性質不可比。
波斯灣國家處境最為矛盾。它們不是戰爭發起方，卻承受伊朗報復性打擊的主要衝擊。沙烏地阿拉伯今年第三季度預算赤字達224億美元，卡達液化天然氣設施遭襲致年收入損失約200億美元。
安聯貿易評估，波斯灣合作委員會(GCC)今年GDP將萎縮4%，累計損失未來產出約7900億美元。在此財政狀況下，要求再付471億美元幾乎不可，波斯灣國家料將「悄悄抵制」，辯稱已通過防務合作、基地支持等付過帳，替代補償形式如投資、軍購等，本質是將既有事務重新包裝。
以色列是新變量。尼坦雅胡對要求保持沉默，背景是川普宣布年底前停止對以每年約40億美元軍援。尼坦雅胡曾提出未來十年將軍援降至零。川普雙重施壓：切斷未來援助並追討過去成本。但471億美元對以色列同樣缺乏依據，美國自1991年後從未要求以色列「償還」費用。
分析人士認為，川普開出帳單未必真正落實，波斯灣國家和以色列清楚這是政治姿態，回應方式將是等待其注意力轉移到下一個目標上。
paras_en: Three days after his disastrous midterm election loss, President Trump on a TV show for the first time singled out Israel, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait, demanding they "100%" reimburse the United States for its spending on the Iran war. He said, "We’ll take all that money back, because without us they wouldn’t exist at all." According to a Pentagon estimate, the cost of the Iran war had reached $47.1 billion as of Oct. 16.

Several Middle‑East analysts say the move is more a political signal than a feasible policy. A Chatham House expert suggested Trump’s remarks are best understood as a political posture; a scholar from Kuwait University said the comments are aimed at a domestic U.S. audience, though Gulf states will interpret them similarly. Analysts also note that Trump is looking for a scapegoat after the midterms to divert attention from his defeat.

Historically, the cost‑sharing after the 1991 Gulf War was possible because it was authorized by the United Nations, whereas the 2026 Iran conflict was launched jointly by the U.S. and Israel without fully informing Gulf states in advance, making the two situations incomparable.

Gulf states find themselves in the most contradictory position. They did not initiate the war, yet they bear the brunt of Iran’s retaliatory strikes. Saudi Arabia’s third‑quarter budget deficit this year reached $22.4 billion, and attacks on Qatar’s liquefied natural gas facilities caused an estimated annual revenue loss of about $20 billion.

Allianz Trade estimates that the Gulf Cooperation Council’s GDP will contract by 4% this year, amounting to a cumulative loss of future output of roughly $790 billion. In that fiscal context, asking for an additional $4.71 billion is virtually impossible; Gulf states are expected to “quietly resist,” arguing they have already contributed through defense cooperation, base support and other accounting measures, and that alternative compensation such as investments or arms purchases merely re‑package existing obligations.

Israel is a new variable. Prime Minister Netanyahu has remained silent on the demand, while Trump announced he would halt the roughly $4 billion per‑year U.S. military aid to Israel by year‑end. Netanyahu has previously suggested cutting that aid to zero over the next decade. Trump is applying a double pressure: cutting future aid while trying to recover past costs. Yet the $4.71 billion claim has no precedent for Israel, as the United States has never asked Israel to “repay” war expenses since 1991.

Analysts conclude that Trump’s bill is unlikely to be fully enforced; Gulf states and Israel recognize it as a political gesture and are likely to respond by waiting for his attention to shift to the next target.

items.title: 黃仁勳不知黃樂是中國間諜？前CIA官員存疑：「他不可能這麼天真」
items.title_en: Did Jensen Huang Not Know Alice Huang Was a Chinese Spy? Former CIA Officer Doubts: "He Could Not Be That Naïve"
paras: 美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 週一 (9 日) 表示，輝達執行長黃仁勳宣稱完全不知道黃樂(Alice Huang) 涉嫌從事情報活動，對此，前美國中央情報局 (CIA) 中國事務分析師 Dennis Wilder 對此抱持懷疑稱：「他深諳華人文化，不可能這麼天真。」
黃仁勳絕非沒見過世面的小白兔？
《華盛頓郵報》報導，與黃仁勳交往的黃樂曾任輝達高階晶片買家 Megaspeed 的高階主管，美方情報人員懷疑她曾為北京工作。輝達董事會已宣布展開內部調查，新加坡當局也正調查 Megaspeed 是否協助將先進晶片轉運至中國。
美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 週一 (9 日) 表示，他與黃仁勳談過此事，黃仁勳告訴他，自己完全不知道對方涉嫌從事情報活動。
Wilder 對此評價：「這麼說吧，他可不是堪薩斯州托彼卡 (Topeka) 人，即絕非沒見過世面的小白兔，他深諳華人文化，不可能那麼天真。」
從私人關係接近決策圈　晶片買家身分也受關注
Wilder 指出，情報機構可以透過私人關係接近掌握敏感資訊的人。即使接觸者未受過正式情報訓練，也可能藉由這層關係接觸原本難以接近的人員或取得敏感資訊。
黃仁勳掌握輝達的商業決策，也代表公司與華府就晶片政策溝通，使這段關係受到國安界關注。
黃樂曾任職的 Megaspeed 採購輝達高階晶片。新加坡當局正在調查，這家公司是否透過東南亞將先進晶片轉運至中國。
新加坡內政部上月表示，不容許企業利用與新加坡的關聯，刻意規避或違反其他國家的出口管制。
黃樂是否參與任何轉運，以及相關交易是否與她和黃仁勳的關係有關，仍未有公開調查結論。
1980 年代曾攔下攜磁片赴北京主管　企業拒絕配合起訴
黃仁勳婚外情風波，亦讓美國科技業長期面對的反間諜問題再度受到關注。
曾參與辦案的前美國聯邦調查局 (FBI) 反間諜探員 LaRae Quy 指出，早在 1980 年代末期，FBI 就曾鎖定一名涉嫌替中國從事情報活動的矽谷科技公司主管。
該公司當時從事可用於軍事用途的機密研究，探員跟監並監聽這位高層，最後在他企圖攜帶一張磁片從舊金山飛往北京時將他逮捕。
不過，案件在逮捕後失去進展。
Quy說，該公司擔心負面報導，拒絕配合後續起訴，聯邦官員也未繼續追究。
她回憶，當時有企業寧可承受技術外流的損失，也不願面對案件曝光可能帶來的聲譽與股價衝擊。
AI 競爭升高　美方查辦商業機密竊取與晶片走私
如今，美方追查的範圍已涵蓋 AI 超級電腦架構與先進晶片的跨境流向。
美國法院今年 1 月裁定，前 Google 工程師丁林葳 (Linwei Ding) 所涉 7 項經濟間諜罪及 7 項竊取商業機密罪均成立。案件涉及逾 2,000 頁有關 Google AI 超級電腦架構的機密資料。
美國執法機關也查辦多起涉嫌將輝達先進技術轉運至中國的案件。
其中一案規模約 1.6 億美元，涉案人員被控以不實出貨文件規避出口管制。
另一起案件涉及約 25 億美元的 AI 伺服器採購，檢方指控相關受管制技術遭轉運至中國。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday (the 9th) that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang claimed he had no knowledge that Alice Huang was suspected of engaging in intelligence activities, and former CIA China analyst Dennis Wilder expressed skepticism, saying, "He is well-versed in Chinese culture and could not be that naïve."
Jensen Huang is far from being an inexperienced newcomer?

The Washington Post reported that Alice Huang, who has dealings with Jensen Huang, previously held a senior executive position at Nvidia's high‑end chip buyer Megaspeed, and U.S. intelligence officials suspect she may have worked for Beijing. Nvidia's board has announced an internal investigation, and Singapore authorities are also probing whether Megaspeed helped ship advanced chips to China.
President Trump said on Monday (the 9th) that he had discussed the matter with Jensen Huang, who told him he was completely unaware of any intelligence‑related allegations against the other party.
Wilder commented, "In other words, he's not a small‑town kid from Topeka, Kansas – certainly not an inexperienced newcomer. He knows Chinese culture inside out and could not be that naïve."
Approaching the decision‑making circle through personal ties – the chip buyer’s identity also draws attention

Wilder noted that intelligence agencies can use personal relationships to get close to people who hold sensitive information. Even if the contact lacks formal intelligence training, the relationship can provide access to otherwise hard‑to‑reach personnel or sensitive data.
Jensen Huang controls Nvidia’s business decisions and also represents the company in communications with Washington on chip policy, making this relationship a focus for national‑security officials.
Megaspeed, where Alice Huang previously worked, purchased high‑end Nvidia chips. Singapore authorities are investigating whether the firm used Southeast Asia to reroute advanced chips to China.
Singapore’s Ministry of Home Affairs said last month that companies are not allowed to use ties to Singapore to deliberately evade or violate other countries’ export controls.
Whether Alice Huang participated in any rerouting and whether related transactions are linked to her relationship with Jensen Huang remain without a public investigative conclusion.
In the 1980s, a senior official who tried to take a magnetic disk to Beijing was stopped – the company refused to cooperate with prosecution
Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair scandal has also revived attention to the long‑standing counter‑espionage issues facing the U.S. tech sector.
Former FBI counter‑espionage agent LaRae Quy, who worked on the case, said that as early as the late 1980s the FBI had targeted a senior Silicon Valley tech executive suspected of spying for China.

The company at the time was conducting classified research with potential military applications; agents surveilled and tapped the executive, and ultimately arrested him when he attempted to fly a magnetic disk from San Francisco to Beijing.
However, the case stalled after the arrest.
Quy said the company feared negative publicity, refused to cooperate with further prosecution, and federal officials did not pursue the matter further.
She recalled that companies sometimes prefer to endure the loss of technology leakage rather than face the reputational and stock‑price damage that could arise from a public case.
AI competition is intensifying, and U.S. authorities are investigating commercial espionage and chip smuggling.
Today, U.S. investigations cover cross‑border flows of AI supercomputer architectures and advanced chips.

In January this year, a U.S. court found former Google engineer Linwei Ding guilty on seven counts of economic espionage and seven counts of trade‑secret theft, involving over 2,000 pages of confidential material on Google’s AI supercomputer architecture.
U.S. law‑enforcement agencies are also probing multiple cases alleged to involve the transfer of Nvidia’s advanced technology to China.
One case involves roughly $160 million, with defendants charged with using false shipping documents to evade export controls.
Another case concerns about $2.5 billion in AI server purchases, with prosecutors alleging that controlled technology was rerouted to China.

items.title: 輝達客戶Megaspeed為何未列黑名單？貝森特白宮質問盧特尼克
items.title_en: Why Is Nvidia Customer Megaspeed Not Blacklisted? Bessent Questions Lutnick at the White House
paras: 《Axios》報導，美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 上週在白宮戰情室當面追問商務部長盧特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)，為何涉嫌將輝達 (NVDA-US) 先進人工智慧 (AI) 晶片轉運至中國的經銷商 Megaspeed，至今仍未被列入美國商務部的實體清單。
這場交鋒凸顯，川普政府內部對於是否應限制這家輝達大客戶取得美國技術，以及此舉可能對美中貿易關係造成的影響，存在分歧。
據知悉會議內容的人士透露，貝森特在會中問道：「為什麼 Megaspeed 還沒被列入實體清單？」
盧特尼克一時語塞，隨後表示：「我不知道，我會查一下。」
企業一旦被列入實體清單，供應商向其出口、再出口或移轉受管制產品，通常須先取得美國商務部許可，實際限制取決於個別列名條件。
白宮與情報官員自去年秋季促請商務部介入
知情人士報導，白宮與美國情報機構官員自 2025 年秋季起便敦促商務部採取行動。兼任國家安全顧問的國務卿盧比歐 (Marco Rubio) 也曾向盧特尼克提交備忘錄，詳列 Megaspeed 涉及的國安疑慮。
知情人士稱，盧特尼克過去一年多次擋下或撤回其他官員推動的措施，因為擔心對 Megaspeed 出手會使美中貿易關係進一步緊張。
《紐約時報》另報導，輝達介入後，商務部主管出口管制的次長凱斯勒 (Jeffrey Kessler) 曾突然叫停一項針對 Megaspeed 的調查。
貝森特此次追問的是商務部是否對 Megaspeed 採取出口限制，而這項報導則將焦點拉回商務部先前如何處理相關調查。
逾 48 億美元晶片採購受查 輝達董事會調查黃仁勳
據報，Megaspeed 曾採購逾 48 億美元的輝達先進晶片。美方調查焦點在於其中是否有晶片遭轉運至中國、最終流向哪些企業，以及相關交易有無違反美國出口管制。
48 億美元是據報採購總額，實際流入中國的金額仍待釐清。
Megaspeed 前高層黃樂 (Alice Huang) 被指透過與輝達執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 及輝達經銷商的關係，協助中國企業取得晶片。
美國情報官員懷疑黃樂涉及中國情報活動。
輝達上週日披露，黃仁勳向董事會告知兩人的親密關係後，董事會將展開調查。黃仁勳否認知悉任何間諜行動。
《紐約時報》報導，美國官員曾在 5 月向川普簡報黃樂與中國政府的疑似關聯。
川普近日被問及此事時，仍公開肯定黃仁勳，稱他是個正派的人，可能有理由解釋，並表示他為美國做了很出色的工作。
觀察出口許可 黃仁勳在華府的影響力恐受削弱
科技研究機構 Moor Insights & Strategy 執行長 Patrick Moorhead 先前指出，這場風波已削弱黃仁勳在華府推動出口政策的影響力，美國政府日後審查輝達對中出口許可時，可能將此事納入考量。
對輝達而言，近期要觀察的是商務部會否將 Megaspeed 列入實體清單。
若限制進一步擴及其他經銷商或海外轉售管道，輝達面臨的影響就會從單一客戶交易，延伸到更多通路的最終買家查核與出口許可審查。
paras_en: Axios reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent last week confronted Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick face‑to‑face in the White House war room, asking why the Nvidia (NVDA-US) advanced AI chip distributor Megaspeed, which is suspected of shipping chips to China, has not yet been placed on the Commerce Department’s Entity List.

The showdown highlighted internal divisions within the Trump administration over whether this major Nvidia customer should be barred from accessing U.S. technology and the potential impact such a move could have on U.S.–China trade relations.
People familiar with the meeting said Bessent asked, “Why hasn’t Megaspeed been added to the Entity List yet?”
Lutnick was momentarily at a loss for words and later replied, “I don’t know, I’ll look into it.”

When a company is placed on the Entity List, suppliers must generally obtain a Commerce Department license before exporting, re‑exporting, or transferring controlled items to it, and the actual restrictions depend on the specific listing criteria.
The White House and intelligence officials have been urging the Commerce Department to act since last fall.

Sources reported that the White House and U.S. intelligence officials have been pressing the Commerce Department since the autumn of 2025. National Security Advisor and Secretary of State Marco Rubio also submitted a memorandum to Lutnick outlining national‑security concerns involving Megaspeed.

Sources said Lutnick has repeatedly blocked or withdrawn measures proposed by other officials over the past year, fearing that taking action against Megaspeed would further strain U.S.–China trade ties.
The New York Times also reported that after Nvidia became involved, Commerce Department deputy assistant secretary for export controls Jeffrey Kessler abruptly halted an investigation into Megaspeed.

Bessent’s line of questioning focused on whether the Commerce Department has imposed export restrictions on Megaspeed, while the report shifts attention back to how the department previously handled related investigations.
More than $4.8 billion in chip purchases under investigation – Nvidia board probes Jensen Huang.

According to reports, Megaspeed purchased over $4.8 billion worth of Nvidia’s advanced chips. U.S. investigators are looking into whether any of those chips were shipped to China, which companies ultimately received them, and whether the transactions violated U.S. export controls.
The $4.8 billion figure reflects the reported total purchase amount; the actual value that may have ended up in China remains to be clarified.
Former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang is accused of leveraging her relationships with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Nvidia’s distributors to help Chinese firms obtain the chips.
U.S. intelligence officials suspect that Alice Huang is involved in Chinese intelligence activities.

Nvidia disclosed last Sunday that after Jensen Huang informed the board of his close relationship with Huang, the board will launch an investigation. Huang denied any knowledge of espionage activities.
The New York Times reported that U.S. officials briefed Trump in May about the alleged link between Alice Huang and the Chinese government.

When Trump was recently asked about the matter, he publicly defended Jensen Huang, calling him an upstanding person who may have a reason to explain himself and saying Huang has done an excellent job for the United States.
Observing export licenses, Jensen Huang’s influence in Washington may be weakened.

Patrick Moorhead, CEO of research firm Moor Insights & Strategy, previously noted that the controversy has eroded Huang’s sway over export‑policy lobbying in Washington, and that the U.S. government may factor the issue into future reviews of Nvidia’s export licenses to China.
For Nvidia, the immediate focus is whether the Commerce Department will add Megaspeed to the Entity List.

If restrictions expand to other distributors or overseas resale channels, Nvidia’s exposure could grow from a single‑customer deal to broader scrutiny of downstream buyers and additional export‑license reviews.

items.title: 馬斯克屢陷風波仍獲股東力挺 黃仁勳也能過關嗎？
items.title_en: Musk Weathered Multiple Controversies Yet Retains Shareholder Support – Can Jensen Huang Also Get Through It?
paras: 黃仁勳婚外情風波讓輝達(NVDA-US)投資人面對一項特斯拉(TSLA-US)股東早已熟悉的考驗：當公司命運與創辦人緊密相連，個人爭議會帶來多大衝擊？馬斯克歷經多次風波仍獲股東支持，但黃仁勳能否同樣過關，仍存在不確定性。
黃仁勳與一名被指涉及中國間諜活動女子的婚外情，引發利益衝突與國家安全疑慮，相關問題仍待調查釐清。輝達股價此前兩個交易日累計下跌約10%，較10月的52周高點回落約31%，凸顯高度依賴單一領導者的「關鍵人物風險」。

創辦人撐起公司成長 接班缺口也成隱憂

Futurum執行長Daniel Newman指出，黃仁勳是非常獨特的執行長，輝達組織比傳統企業更加扁平，幾乎圍繞他的個人願景運作。目前外界不知道有任何明確接班計畫，公司內部也沒有一位公認能在他離職後接棒的領導者。
這種高度依賴創辦人的模式，與馬斯克之於特斯拉相似。聖塔克拉拉大學副教授Jo-Ellen Pozner認為，兩家公司都有強勢創辦人兼執行長，並對董事會發揮重大影響力。
創辦人掌舵確實可能創造可觀財富。哥倫比亞商學院教授Shivaram Rajgopal指出，特斯拉與Meta(META-US)等企業的創辦人，能帶來專業經理人未必具備的活力。
但他強調，董事會仍須履行規劃未來的責任。黃仁勳風波反映部分大型科技公司的脆弱之處：即使已是上市巨頭，運作方式仍可能像私人企業，董事會也受到家族式關係影響。

股東願為報酬承受多少風險 黃仁勳面臨信任考驗

強勢領導者帶來的風險，往往反映在股價波動。報導指出，特斯拉波動程度約為一般股票的兩倍，輝達近期也出現類似情況。
若報酬夠高，投資人可能願意承受震盪。截至周三交易前，輝達過去五年上漲455%，領先標普500近400個百分點；特斯拉同期卻僅上漲約10%，顯示創辦人的光環並不保證持續帶來優異績效。
馬斯克歷經美國證管會罰款與調查、誹謗訴訟，並將心力投入其他企業與政治活動，仍獲投資人支持。特斯拉股東2025年更批准一項潛在價值可達1兆美元的薪酬方案。
黃仁勳也可能挺過風波，但投資人仍須思考：輝達股價包含多少對他個人的信任？若他必須離開，公司由誰接手？這些問題將影響市場如何評估輝達的價值與風險。
paras_en: Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair scandal forces Nvidia (NVDA-US) investors to face a test familiar to Tesla (TSLA-US) shareholders: when a company’s fate is tightly linked to its founder, how much impact can personal controversies have? Musk has survived numerous storms with shareholder backing, but it remains uncertain whether Huang can do the same.

Huang’s alleged affair with a woman accused of involvement in Chinese espionage has raised conflict‑of‑interest and national‑security concerns, issues that are still under investigation. Nvidia’s share price fell about 10% over the previous two trading days, retreating roughly 31% from its 52‑week high in October, highlighting the “key‑person risk” of heavy reliance on a single leader.

Founder‑driven growth and a succession gap are also worries. Futurum CEO Daniel Newman notes that Huang is a uniquely influential CEO and that Nvidia’s organization is flatter than a traditional firm, operating almost entirely around his personal vision. No clear succession plan is known publicly, and there is no recognized internal leader ready to take over if he departs.

This founder‑centric model mirrors Musk’s role at Tesla. Santa Clara University associate professor Jo‑Ellen Pozner says both companies have strong founder‑CEOs who wield significant influence over their boards.

A founder at the helm can indeed generate substantial wealth. Columbia Business School professor Shivaram Rajgopal points out that founders of firms like Tesla and Meta (META‑US) bring a dynamism that professional managers may lack.

However, he stresses that boards must still fulfill their duty to plan for the future. Huang’s scandal exposes a fragility in some large tech firms: even as public giants, they can operate like private companies, with boards swayed by family‑style relationships.

How much risk shareholders are willing to bear for compensation is now under scrutiny, and Huang faces a trust test. The risk associated with strong leaders often shows up in stock volatility. Reports note Tesla’s volatility is about twice that of a typical stock, and Nvidia has shown similar behavior recently.

If compensation is high enough, investors may tolerate the swings. As of Wednesday’s trading, Nvidia has risen 455% over the past five years, outpacing the S&P 500 by nearly 400 percentage points; Tesla, by contrast, has risen only about 10% in the same period, showing that a founder’s halo does not guarantee sustained superior performance.

Musk has endured SEC fines and investigations, defamation lawsuits, and has poured energy into other ventures and political activities, yet still enjoys investor support. Tesla shareholders even approved a potential compensation package in 2025 that could be worth up to $1 trillion.

Huang may also survive the scandal, but investors must consider how much of Nvidia’s price reflects trust in him personally. If he has to leave, who will take over? These questions will shape how the market values Nvidia’s risk and upside.

items.title: 歐洲央行：若年底前未達協議 數位歐元推出時程恐延至2029年後
items.title_en: European Central Bank: If No Agreement by Year‑End, Digital Euro Launch Could Slip Past 2029
paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)發出警訊，指出歐盟若無法在今(2026)年底前就「單一貨幣法案包」達成協議，原定於 2029 年首次發行的數位歐元(Digital Euro)計畫恐面臨延後。
隨著 2026 年僅剩約七周時間，歐洲央行正全力敦促歐盟立法機構加快腳步，以確保整體籌備工作具備明確的法律確定性。
歐洲央行執行董事奇波洛內(Piero Cipollone)於 11 月 10 日出席歐洲議會經濟及貨幣事務委員會時明確指出，立法延宕將直接推遲數位歐元的上路時程。
奇波洛內特別提到了歐盟在基礎設施上的風險，表示目前歐元區高達三分之二的信用卡支付受控制於外國業者，並指出：「近年歐洲已深刻體會到在能源與國防上不能單純依賴第三方，支付領域也是如此。」他警告，延遲發行將加深歐洲對外國支付服務商的依賴，並打擊在地企業的創新發展空間。
同時，歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)也將數位歐元視為關鍵應對方案，並警告指出，錨定美元的私營穩定幣若大規模普及，將可能削弱央行對貨幣政策的掌控能力。
面對大眾對實體貨幣存廢的疑慮，歐洲議會官員Fernando Navarrete Rojas強調，數位歐元的定位十分清晰，「將作為現金的補充手段，絕不會取代現金。」
目前歐洲議會正與歐盟理事會及歐盟執委會展開三方協商。法案談判的核心爭議主要集中於三大面向：個人隱私保護、交易手續費架構以及個人持有限額。
若歐盟能於今年完成立法，歐洲央行預計於 2027 年下半年啟動為期 12 個月的技術試辦計畫，屆時將有 36 家市場營運商、支付服務業者及實體商家參與日常支付情境的實測。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) warned that if the EU fails to reach an agreement on the “single currency law package” by the end of this year (2026), the Digital Euro project originally slated for a first issuance in 2029 could be delayed.
With only about seven weeks left in 2026, the ECB is urging EU legislators to accelerate the process to ensure the overall preparation work has clear legal certainty.

ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone said on 10 November, when speaking to the European Parliament’s Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs, that legislative delays would directly push back the timetable for the Digital Euro’s rollout.

Cipollone highlighted infrastructure risks, noting that roughly two‑thirds of euro‑area card payments are currently controlled by foreign operators, and warned that “Europe has learned in recent years that it cannot rely solely on third parties for energy and defence, and the payments sector is no different.” He cautioned that a postponed launch would deepen Europe’s reliance on foreign payment service providers and curb innovation by local firms.

ECB President Christine Lagarde also framed the Digital Euro as a key response tool, warning that a privately‑issued, dollar‑pegged stablecoin gaining widespread use could erode central banks’ control over monetary policy.

Addressing public concerns about the future of physical cash, European Parliament official Fernando Navarrete Rojas stressed that the Digital Euro’s role is clear: “It will be a complementary means to cash, never a replacement.”

The European Parliament is currently in trilateral talks with the EU Council and the European Commission. The core disputes in the legislative negotiations centre on three issues: personal data protection, transaction fee structures and individual holding limits.

If the EU completes the legislation this year, the ECB expects to launch a 12‑month technical pilot in the second half of 2027, involving 36 market operators, payment service providers and physical merchants testing everyday payment scenarios.

items.title: 美元升息預期重燃 日元跌至一個半月新低 直逼159關卡
items.title_en: Dollar Rate‑Hike Expectations Resurge, Yen Falls to One‑and‑a‑Half‑Month Low Near 159 Barrier
paras: 日元周三(11日)亞市走勢持續疲軟，兌美元匯率回落至158.97附近，盤中跌幅約0.14%，並創下9月下旬以來約一個半月的新低紀錄。
市場分析指出，美國高於預期的CPI數據激發市場對美國聯準會升息的預期，美債殖利率大幅攀升帶動美日利差擴大，吸引利差交易資金及日本進口商的實需買盤進場，進一步推低日元。
隨著通膨疑慮再起，聯準會多位官員發表鷹派言論，亦為美元提供強勁支撐。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)在通膨數據公布前即表示，若10月核心通膨達到0.3%，央行應考慮在下個月評估升息2碼(50個基點)。數據公布後，達拉斯聯邦準備銀行總裁洛根(Lorie Logan)暗示更強勁的通膨可能需要加快升息步伐；芝加哥聯邦準備銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)更直言，這份物價報告「是另一份令人不安、甚至是接近令人困擾的報告」。
面對市場迅速計入聯準會加速升息的可能性，第一生命經濟研究所經濟學家Seiji Katsurahata提出不同觀點。Katsurahata認為，市場目前對聯準會12月升息2碼的猜測顯得過度反應；隨著市場定價最終穩定在升息1碼(25個基點)，短期美債殖利率應會趨於正常化，美元匯率的上行空間預期將受限。
同時，分析師認為日本銀行(BOJ)可能必須跟進升息，以防止日元進一步走貶。日本銀行最新會議意見摘要顯示，決策官員對通膨上行風險仍保持高度警惕，並支持採取進一步升息措施。受美國國債殖利率飆升影響，日本10年期基準國債殖利率當日亦攀升至2.785%。
日元持續貶值雖提升日本出口商的盈利能力，但進口能源與原料成本上漲已顯著加重企業負擔，並引發國內消費者物價壓力。
paras_en: The yen continued its weak performance in Asian markets on Wednesday (the 11th), slipping back to around 158.97 per dollar, down about 0.14% intraday, marking a new low of about one and a half months since late September.

Market analysis points out that U.S. CPI data that came in above expectations sparked expectations of Fed rate hikes, causing U.S. Treasury yields to surge and widening the U.S.-Japan interest rate differential, attracting carry‑trade funds and genuine buying from Japanese importers, further pushing the yen lower.
With inflation concerns resurfacing, several Fed officials have made hawkish remarks, also providing strong support for the dollar.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said before the inflation data release that if core inflation hits 0.3% in October, the central bank should consider evaluating a 2‑point (50‑basis‑point) rate hike next month. After the data were released, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan hinted that stronger inflation might require a faster pace of hikes; Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee was even more blunt, calling the price report “another unsettling, even bordering on troubling, report.”

Facing the market’s rapid pricing in of a faster Fed tightening, Seiji Katsurahata, an economist at the First Life Economic Research Institute, offered a different view. Katsurahata believes the market’s speculation that the Fed will raise rates by 2 points in December is an overreaction; as the market pricing settles at a 1‑point (25‑basis‑point) hike, short‑term Treasury yields should normalize and the upside potential for the dollar is expected to be limited.

At the same time, analysts think the Bank of Japan may have to follow suit with rate hikes to prevent further yen depreciation. The latest BOJ meeting minutes show that policymakers remain highly vigilant about inflation upside risks and support taking additional tightening measures. Affected by the surge in U.S. Treasury yields, Japan’s 10‑year benchmark government bond yield also rose to 2.785% that day.

While the yen’s continued depreciation boosts the profitability of Japanese exporters, higher import costs for energy and raw materials have significantly increased corporate burdens and sparked domestic consumer price pressures.

items.title: 香港上市債券市場重大突破 人民幣歷史性超越美元
items.title_en: Hong Kong Listed Bond Market Achieves Major Breakthrough as RMB Historically Overtakes USD
paras: 2026年前三季度，香港上市債券市場迎來歷史性轉折。信用評級機構大公國際香港最新統計顯示，以離岸人民幣計價的債券(簡稱「點心債」)占總發行額比重達37%，歷史性超越美元債券的33%，使離岸人民幣正式躍升為香港上市債券市場最大的發行幣種。
統計指出，截至2026年9月末，香港上市點心債發行規模已達2,868億元人民幣，一舉超越2025年全年總額，港交所上市發行數量達117檔，明顯多於美元債的77檔。
分析指出，在美國聯準會維持高利率背景下，美元債融資成本高企，使點心債的成本優勢更加凸顯。此外，發行主體呈現多元化與國際化趨勢，除了中資科技企業騰訊、京東與國家電網等機構外，美國安達保險、匈牙利國家儲蓄商業銀行及哈薩克國家石油天然氣公司等外資機構也積極赴港發行，顯示點心債正加速演變為全球投資者認可的離岸資產配置標竿。
針對市場新局，香港特區政府財經事務及庫務局副局長陳浩濂在交流會中明確指出，香港正「從一個金融的城市，走向金融賦能的城市」。
陳浩濂強調，金融是香港最大優勢，全球金融中心排名世界第三、亞洲第一，未來特區政府將以「金融+」為核心抓手，深化金融與科技、綠色及民生實體領域的融合，充分發揮香港作為「超級聯繫人」與「超級增值人」的角色。
發表研究報告的大公國際香港則提醒，點心債市場快速擴容的同時，仍面臨期限結構與流動性需求錯配、歐美長線資金參與深度不足，以及債匯聯動機制與風險對沖工具尚待完善等結構性挑戰。該機構強調，建構高質量的跨境信用生態，將是推動離岸人民幣債市從「規模擴張」走向「質效提升」的關鍵支撐。
paras_en: In the first three quarters of 2026, Hong Kong's listed bond market experienced a historic turning point. The latest statistics from rating agency Dagong International Hong Kong show that offshore RMB‑denominated bonds (commonly called “dim sum bonds”) accounted for 37% of total issuance, a historic overtaking of USD bonds at 33%, making offshore RMB the largest currency for issuance in Hong Kong’s listed bond market.

The data indicate that by the end of September 2026, the issuance volume of Hong Kong‑listed dim sum bonds had reached RMB 286.8 billion, surpassing the entire 2025 annual total. A total of 117 dim sum bond issues were listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, clearly outnumbering the 77 USD‑denominated issues.

Analysts point out that, with the U.S. Federal Reserve maintaining high interest rates, the financing cost of USD bonds remains elevated, highlighting the cost advantage of dim sum bonds. Moreover, issuers are becoming more diversified and international: besides Chinese tech giants such as Tencent and JD.com and state‑owned entities like State Grid, foreign institutions such as U.S. insurer AIG, Hungary’s National Savings Commercial Bank and Kazakhstan’s National Oil and Gas Company are actively issuing in Hong Kong, indicating that dim sum bonds are rapidly evolving into a globally recognised offshore asset‑allocation benchmark.

Regarding the new market dynamics, Hong Kong SAR Government Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Chan Ho‑lin, said at a briefing that Hong Kong is moving “from a financial city to a financially‑empowered city.”

Chan Ho‑lin stressed that finance is Hong Kong’s greatest advantage, ranking third worldwide and first in Asia as a global financial centre. The SAR government will centre its strategy on “Finance+,” deepening the integration of finance with technology, green initiatives and real‑economy sectors, fully leveraging Hong Kong’s role as a “super connector” and “super value‑adder.”

Dagong International Hong Kong, which released the research report, warned that while the dim sum bond market is expanding rapidly, it still faces structural challenges such as mismatches between maturity structure and liquidity demand, insufficient participation from long‑term European and American capital, and underdeveloped bond‑FX linkage mechanisms and hedging tools. The agency stressed that building a high‑quality cross‑border credit ecosystem will be key to moving the offshore RMB bond market from “scale expansion” to “quality and efficiency improvement.”

items.title: 伊朗威脅行動升級！紐時：對伊極限經濟戰引火上身  貝森特搬進軍事基地避險
items.title_en: Iran Threatens to Escalate Actions! NYT: Extreme Economic War on Iran Backfires, Berrens Moves to Military Base for Safety
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，主導對伊朗制裁的美國財長貝森特已搬入軍事基地，因美方官員認為伊朗針對美國現任及前任官員的行動正進入更深入階段。
《紐約時報》引述三位知情人士報導，美國財長貝森特因自8月起主導川普政府對伊朗的極限經濟施壓，成為德黑蘭重點打擊目標，目前已離開華府住所，轉入軍事基地保護。貝森特透過加強制裁與限制貿易路線，試圖切斷伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊的資金來源。
美國財政部發言人強調，他不會因威脅退縮，官員坦言尚不清楚針對貝森特的威脅有多嚴重，但伊朗過往針對特定個人的威脅常有具體行動指向。
報導指出，去年至少6位美國高官也採取類似措施，像是白宮辦公廳主任米勒等，部分威脅甚至與委內瑞拉局勢有關。威脅蔓延也促使美國調整海外部署。美國國務院上月要求中東地區雇員提升警戒並縮編使領館，因懷疑英國一處軍事基地面臨恐攻陰謀，美軍緊急撤走轟炸機。
這場安全風暴根源於2020年美軍擊殺伊朗將領蘇萊曼尼，伊朗隨後將川普列為報復目標。2024年，美國起訴一名伊朗革命衛隊人員涉嫌策劃謀殺川普。拜登政府曾為當年行動團隊成員提供保護，但川普重返白宮後撤銷了這些安排。
川普政府希望透過經濟制裁迫使德黑蘭讓步，避免重啟大規模軍事行動。儘管伊朗經濟萎縮、貨幣貶值，但情報顯示其強硬派決心不惜代價維持政權，單靠施壓能否改變立場仍是未知數。從貝森特轉入基地到中東人員縮編，伊朗的威脅正深刻影響美國各層面的安全佈局。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that U.S. Treasury Secretary Berrens, who leads sanctions against Iran, has moved into a military base because U.S. officials say Iran’s actions against current and former U.S. officials are entering a deeper phase.

The New York Times, citing three insiders, reported that Treasury Secretary Berrens, who has been spearheading the Trump administration’s extreme economic pressure on Iran since August, has become a primary target for Tehran and has left his Washington residence for protection at a military base. Berrens is trying to cut off funding to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps by tightening sanctions and restricting trade routes.

A Treasury Department spokesperson stressed that he will not back down in the face of threats; officials admitted they do not yet know how serious the threat to Berrens is, but noted that Iran’s past threats against specific individuals have often been accompanied by concrete actions.

The report notes that at least six senior U.S. officials took similar steps last year, such as White House Office of Management and Budget director Miller, with some threats linked to the situation in Venezuela. The spreading threats have also prompted the United States to adjust overseas deployments. Last month the State Department ordered Middle‑East staff to increase alert levels and downsize embassies after suspecting a British military base of being the target of a terror plot, prompting U.S. forces to urgently withdraw bombers.

The security storm stems from the 2020 U.S. strike that killed Iranian commander Qassem Soleimani, after which Iran named former President Trump as a retaliation target. In 2024 the United States indicted an IRGC member for allegedly plotting to assassinate Trump. The Biden administration had provided protection for members of the original operation team, but those arrangements were cancelled after Trump returned to the White House.

The Trump administration hoped that economic sanctions would force Tehran to concede and avoid a large‑scale military restart. Although Iran’s economy has contracted and its currency has depreciated, intelligence shows hardliners remain determined to preserve the regime at any cost, leaving it uncertain whether pressure alone can shift their stance. From Berrens’s move to a base to the downsizing of Middle‑East staff, Iran’s threat is profoundly reshaping U.S. security planning across the board.

據美國勞工部公布的數據顯示，因能源價格漲幅回落，10月消費者物價指數(CPI)環比漲幅降至0.4%，但剔除波動較大的食品和能源價格後的核心CPI連續第三個月環比上漲0.3%，凸顯核心通脹依然頑固，與此同時，據美國FED理事沃勒則稱如果核心通脹繼續偏離目標，FED將需要採取更激進的貨幣政策措施，達拉斯聯邦儲備銀行總裁洛根也稱更快行動是可能的，提振美元兌日圓至158.85高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於159.20-40，支撐於158.40-60。
◆EUR/USD

據澳洲國民銀行(NAB)調查顯示，10月企業現況指數下降1點至負2，為2020年8月以來最低，企業信心指數也降至負15，表明在借貸成本上升和成本壓力高企之際，國內需求正在放緩，不過油價下跌推動風險資產上漲，且紐西蘭大選結果顯示，現任總理拉克森領導的三黨聯合政府以兩席的優勢獲得多數席位，支撐澳幣、紐元大致守住漲幅；此外，據歐洲央行(ECB)首席經濟學家連恩對彭博表示，ECB可能需要在12月加息，加入了眾多主張該央行今年第三次加息的政策制定者行列，令歐元兌美元升至1.1251高點。
隨後美國10月通脹數據高於預期，推動市場加大對借貸成本進一步上升的押注，根據CME FedWatch工具，目前預計FED於12月加息概率接近99%，打擊歐元兌美元下滑至1.1143低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1190-1.1210，支撐於1.1125-45。

英國零售業聯盟(BRC)週二公布的調查顯示，10月商店銷售增長1.5%，創6月以來最大增幅，顯示儘管汽油價格上漲且部分家庭為等待黑色星期五優惠而削減部分類別的支出，但英國10月零售銷售仍實現溫和增長，而且英國央行(BOE)副總裁隆巴爾代利在接受英國衛報採訪時表示，她不排除在12月投票支持加息的可能性，支撐英鎊兌美元盤整於1.3458高點；隨後美國FED理事沃勒鷹派言論以及高於市場預期的通膨數據，衝擊英鎊兌美元下跌至1.3308低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3360-80，支撐於1.3290-1.3310。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美CPI火熱、Fed理事鷹派談話強化升息預期 美元攀高
items.title_en: New York FX Market: US CPI Hot, Fed Governor’s Hawkish Remarks Strengthen Rate‑Hike Expectations, Dollar Rises
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周二(10日)攀高，美國通膨數據比預期火熱，強化了聯準會(Fed)下月升息機率。
追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)上漲0.57%，報102.26。
歐元兌美元下跌0.55%，報1.116美元。美元兌日元上漲0.55%，報158.80日元。元兌瑞士法郎上漲0.71%，報0.8252瑞郎。
美國勞工部公布的數據顯示，美國10月消費者物價指數(CPI)月增0.4%，高於經濟學家預估的月增0.3%。
數據公布後，美元兌一籃子貨幣延續漲勢。通常與Fed利率預期同步變動的美國2年期公債殖利率也大幅跳升，最新上漲18.44個基點至4.731%。
渣打銀行(Standard Chartered Bank) G10外匯研究及北美總體策略全球主管Steve Englander表示，市場對這份數據感到措手不及，因為數據似乎支持Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周二發表的鷹派談話。華勒當時表示，Fed應在下個月升息，以提高短期借貸成本。
Englander說：「華勒的談話如此鷹派，引起市場注意。美元和利率的這波漲勢就是從那時開始的。」
他表示：「CPI數據也偏熱，尤其是通膨似乎相當廣泛，因此市場開始感到擔憂。美國11月3日期中選舉以來，美元走勢大多受到油價交易主導，但現在市場人士開始認為：『我們是不是看錯了重點？真正應該關注的是通膨風險，以及Fed的政策動向。』」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，市場目前預估Fed 12月升息的機率接近91%。
對貿易情勢與市場情緒較為敏感的澳幣兌美元下跌0.89%，報0.686美元。紐元兌美元下跌0.56%，報0.56美元。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta說：「短期內美元走弱的空間仍然有限。勞動市場展現韌性，加上國內經濟活動穩健，持續支撐美國消費，也降低經濟突然放緩的風險，很難看到年底前持續走貶。」
